title.rendered: Apple Updates Invites App With Home Screen Widgets

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple adds widget support to Invites app: You can now see a live countdown to upcoming events directly on your iPhone home screen.
  • Adding the Invites widget is simple: Long-press the home screen, tap Add Widgets, and pick from small, medium, or large countdown views.
  • Invites app creates custom event invitations: It lets you design invites with backgrounds, fonts, and weather info, but making events requires an active iCloud+ subscription.
  • Widget update hints at Apple’s plans: The limited countdown feature suggests Apple still sees potential for the Invites app and may expand functionality later.
  • Expectations remain cautious for now: While the widget boosts visibility, its current usefulness is narrow, so upcoming updates will determine long-term user adoption.

Just hours after announcing its upcoming “Awe Dropping” iPhone 17 launch event, Apple quietly pushed an update to the Apple Invites app. The refresh adds home screen widget support, giving users a live countdown to their next scheduled event without needing to open the app.

How to Add the Invites App’s Widget

After updating, users can long-press the home screen, hit the Edit button in the top right, and select “Add Widgets” from the menu. Searching for the Invites app reveals three widget sizes – small, medium, and large. Functionality doesn’t change between them, however. Each widget only displays the number of days left until the next event, with no additional data.

Tapping the widget takes you straight into the Invites app, where full event details are still stored.

What is the Invites app?

Apple introduced the Invites app back in February as a way to build and manage custom event invitations. Users can design invites with background images, different fonts, directions, and even weather information attached.

The catch is that while the app itself is free, creating an event requires an iCloud+ subscription. That paid tier starts at $0.99 per month, meaning the widget mainly benefits those already paying for Apple’s upgraded iCloud plan.

A small but telling update

On the surface, widget support may look like a minor addition, but it signals that Apple still sees potential in Invites despite its quiet rollout earlier this year. The limitation to a simple countdown, though, may leave some wondering if Apple intends to expand functionality later on.

Have you tried the Invites widget on your home screen yet? Let us know how useful it actually feels in day-to-day use.

title.rendered: Apple’s “Awe Dropping” Event Set for Sept 9: iPhone 17 Air and More Coming

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple’s September 2025 event confirmed: Happening September 9 at Apple Park, the keynote will stream worldwide with major product launches across iPhone, wearables, and software.
  • iPhone 17 series takes center stage: Apple will unveil four iPhone 17 models, with the ultra-thin iPhone 17 Air replacing the Plus lineup as a standout redesign.
  • Wearables and accessories refresh: Apple Watch Series 11, Watch Ultra 3, AirPods Pro 3, and potential Apple TV 4K and HomePod updates are expected.
  • iOS 26 debuts with Liquid Glass: Apple will highlight iOS 26’s new Liquid Glass interface and demonstrate tighter cross-device integration during the keynote.
  • Event schedule and rollout: The keynote starts 10 AM PT, with preorders from September 12 and retail availability beginning September 19.

Apple has locked in September 9, 2025, for its next iPhone launch event, officially branded “Awe Dropping.” The keynote will take place at the company’s Apple Park campus in Cupertino and, as usual, will be streamed worldwide. This year’s showcase is set to center on the iPhone 17 family, which Apple is framing as the next major step in its hardware lineup.

What to Expect at Apple’s September Event

The star of the show will almost certainly be the iPhone 17 series. Apple is preparing four models: the standard iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, and a new entry called the iPhone 17 Air. The Air is positioned as an ultra-thin replacement for the outgoing Plus model, and industry watchers are treating it as one of the most significant design shifts since the iPhone X.

Alongside the new iPhones, Apple is also expected to refresh its wearables. The Apple Watch Series 11 and the third-generation Apple Watch Ultra are both on deck, while AirPods Pro 3 could bring upgrades in both sound and health features. Updates to the Apple TV 4K and HomePod hardware are rumored to round out the hardware lineup, though Apple has not confirmed these.

Software will also take the spotlight. iOS 26, featuring the new “Liquid Glass” interface, will be demoed on stage to show how the redesigned system fits across Apple’s latest devices. Apple typically uses the iPhone event to frame software as part of the ecosystem story, so expect live demos during the keynote.

Event Timings and Availability

The keynote begins at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET (10:30 PM IST) and will be broadcast on Apple’s website, the Apple TV app, and YouTube. Preorders are expected to open on September 12, with first shipments and in-store availability beginning September 19. The public rollout of iOS 26 should follow within days of the event, landing on compatible iPhones shortly after the keynote.

Apple’s Next Chapter

This year’s lineup could be one of Apple’s more ambitious fall launches. The iPhone 17 Air in particular is drawing attention as a sign of Apple experimenting with thinner hardware after years of incremental updates. Combined with iOS 26’s new design language, Apple is signaling that it wants this cycle to feel like a reset rather than a simple refresh.

Whether it lives up to the branding is another matter. Apple’s “Awe Dropping” name suggests it wants this keynote to be remembered, but expectations will be difficult to match given the company’s history of tightly staged product launches.

Would the arrival of an iPhone 17 Air make a difference for you, or does it feel like another iteration? Share your take on Apple’s September event below.

keyPoints.title: Apple's September 2025 Launch Event
keyPoints.explanation: Set for September 9, 2025, at Apple Park, this event will stream globally and introduce the iPhone 17 series along with updates to wearables and software.

keyPoints.title: Main Highlights – iPhone 17 Series
keyPoints.explanation: The spotlight will be on four new iPhone 17 models, including the innovative iPhone 17 Air, which marks a major design shift as a thin replacement for the Plus model.

keyPoints.title: Wearables and Hardware Updates
keyPoints.explanation: Expect updates to the Apple Watch Series 11, third-generation Apple Watch Ultra, AirPods Pro 3, and possibly refreshed Apple TV 4K and HomePod models.

keyPoints.title: Software Showcase – iOS 26 and More
keyPoints.explanation: iOS 26 with the new Liquid Glass interface will be demonstrated, highlighting how the latest software integrates across Apple's devices during the event.

keyPoints.title: Event Timings and Launch Details
keyPoints.explanation: Starting at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET, the keynote will be available on various platforms, with preorders beginning September 12 and in-store availability from September 19.

His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to Tell If AirPods Are Fake: 17 Ways to Spot Counterfeits Like a Pro

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Spotting fake AirPods Pro protects your health, money, and privacy, since counterfeits use cheap materials, lack warranty, and may not be safe.
  • Check packaging quality closely—Apple boxes use sharp printing and accurate fonts, while fakes often show dull colors, typos, or flimsy construction.
  • Always verify the serial number on Apple’s official site, since invalid or already-activated numbers are a red flag for counterfeit products.
  • Examine build quality and sensor functions carefully, as genuine AirPods Pro have precise weight, size, and working LEDs and sensors that fakes often miss.
  • Real AirPods Pro support firmware updates and iOS features like Spatial Audio and Find My, while fakes usually skip these advanced functions.

AirPods Pro are premium Apple accessories—but with high demand comes a flood of fakes. Some counterfeits are so well-made that even experienced users get fooled. If you’ve ever wondered whether your AirPods Pro are the real deal, you’re not alone.

In this comprehensive guide, I’ll show you exactly how to spot fake AirPods Pro. From packaging and sound quality to serial number checks and iOS compatibility—this checklist covers it all.

Table of Contents
  • Why You Must Check for Fake AirPods Pro
  • Packaging and Box Details
    • 1. Inspect the Quality of the Box
    • 2. Font and Print Accuracy
  • Check if AirPods Pro Are Real by Serial Number
    • 3. Use Apple's Serial Number Checker
  • Physical Appearance Differences
    • 4. Dimensions and Weight
    • 5. LED Light Differences
    • 6. Engraving and Shape
  • Charging Case Comparison
    • 7. Lid Tension Test
    • 8. Hinge and Port Design
  • Bluetooth Connectivity Checks
    • 9. Pairing Animation
  • Sound Quality and ANC Test
    • 10. Audio Experience
    • 11. Active Noise Cancellation
  • iOS Features and Compatibility
    • 12. Feature Verification
  • Price and Purchase Source
    • 13. Too-Good-To-Be-True Deals
    • 14. Choose a Reputable Seller
  • Firmware Version and Updates
    • 15. Update Functionality
  • Microphone and Call Quality Test
    • 16. Phone Call Test
  • Build Material and Finish Quality
    • 17. Touch and Feel
  • Accessory and Documentation Review
  • Barcode and Label Scanning
  • Real-Life Testing Techniques
  • Bonus: Expert Advice and Community Forums
  • What to Do If You Bought a Fake Pair of AirPods Pro
  • Spot the Fake AirPods Pro Before They Fool You!

Why You Must Check for Fake AirPods Pro

Identifying fake AirPods Pro isn’t just about performance—it’s about protecting your wallet, health, and privacy.

  • Health concerns: Fake earbuds are often made from substandard, unregulated materials that can irritate your ears or cause long-term hearing issues.
  • No Apple warranty: Counterfeit AirPods are not covered by AppleCare or support.
  • Wasted money: You’ll get poor sound, unreliable battery life, and zero updates.
  • Ethical issues: Buying fakes supports illegal markets and shady vendors.

Packaging and Box Details 

The moment you get your AirPods Pro, the box is your first clue. 

1. Inspect the Quality of the Box 

Genuine AirPods Pro come in a high-quality, sturdy box. It should feel smooth, durable, and professionally printed. Fake boxes? They often feel cheap, flimsy, with dull colors or a faded logo.

Therefore, hold the box in your hands and give it a good look. If it feels like something you’d find in a dollar store, that’s a red flag. 

2. Font and Print Accuracy 

Apple is obsessive about details, and its box text is no exception. The font on a real AirPods Pro box is clean, evenly spaced, and perfectly aligned. Fake boxes often mess this up—letters might be too thick, too thin, or slightly off-center. 

Additionally, there may be many spelling mistakes, misprints, grammatical errors, or unusual information. Compare the text to pictures of real AirPods Pro boxes online. If something looks “off,” trust your gut and dig deeper. 

Check if AirPods Pro Are Real by Serial Number

Serial numbers are unique identifiers for every product. The easiest way to tell if an AirPods Pro is fake is if it isn’t registered in the Apple directory. 

3. Use Apple’s Serial Number Checker 

Your AirPods serial number is under the lid of the charging case or on the side of the box. Once you have it, head to Apple’s official Check Device Coverage website. Type in the serial number, fill in the CAPTCHA and hit enter.

 

If Apple says the number is invalid, you’ve got a fake. Some sneaky counterfeiters reuse real serial numbers, so search the number and see if it’s already activated. If multiple people report the same serial being used, that’s a warning sign. 

Physical Appearance Differences 

No matter the scammers’ perfection, it is impossible to completely replicate the original AirPods. So, you must carefully observe the physical appearance for the most minor mistakes.

 

4. Dimensions and Weight 

Fake AirPods Pro might look similar at a glance, but they often differ in weight or size. Real AirPods Pro have a specific heft—light but solid. If you have access to a friend’s genuine pair, compare them side by side. Fakes might feel too heavy or oddly light. A kitchen scale can help if you want to get precise. 

You can also examine the AirPods’ base. These magnet-enabled sections are designated for making contact with the case while charging. If your AirPod is fake, an oval-shaped area will cover more than half of the base. In genuine AirPods Pro, this area is evenly distributed. 

5. LED Light Differences 

The LED light on the front of the charging case is a dead giveaway. On real AirPods Pro, it’s perfectly centered and glows with a smooth, clean green or amber color. Fakes often have lights that are off-center, flicker, or look like a weird bright color. Open and close the case a few times to see how the light behaves. 

6. Engraving and Shape 

Apple offers a sleek customization feature on AirPods cases, which is absent from counterfeit ones. You can request to engrave a memoji, text, or emoji of your choice on AirPods Pro before purchasing. An engraved AirPod stands out from fake AirPods, and there is a low possibility that third-party websites can offer customization on fake AirPods.

 

Even if the fake ones offer engravings, they might look sloppy, with uneven fonts or rough edges. Also, inspect the AirPod’s earpiece shape—real ones are smooth and oval, whereas you’ll find circular earpieces in fake AirPods Pro. 

Additionally, look for the sensors that detect when the earbuds are inside the ear, pause or play the audio, or are put back in the case. AirPods Pro also has a force sensor on the stem that allows you to control playback, answer calls, and activate Siri.

 

In contrast, fake AirPods Pro lacks these sensors and has a button instead of a force sensor. 

Charging Case Comparison 

Apple AirPods Pro charging case also has minute details that can help you spot the fake ones. 

7. Lid Tension Test 

Open the charging case and close the lid slowly. A real AirPods Pro case has a magnetic feel and doesn’t snap shut loudly. Fake cases often feel wobbly, snap shut too hard, or open too easily. Play with the lid a few times to get a sense of it. If it feels cheap, it probably is. 

8. Hinge and Port Design 

On genuine AirPods Pro, the hinge is sleek, seamless, and moves like butter. Fake hinges might look clunky, with visible gaps or rough edges. Also, check the charging port at the bottom. It should be centered and lined up with metal plates. If it looks off-center or the cable wiggles too much, that’s a bad sign. 

The AirPods Pro case supports MagSafe wireless charging. So, put it on a charger and see if it juices up. 

Bluetooth Connectivity Checks 

Let’s assume that everything on the packaging is perfect to a certain level and seems original. But even if you miss out on physical details, there are still ways to spot fake AirPods Pro. 

9. Pairing Animation 

One of the coolest things about AirPods Pro is how they pair with an iPhone. Open the case near your iPhone, and a smooth pop-up animation should appear, showing the AirPods Pro and their battery levels.  

Fakes might trigger a generic Bluetooth prompt or show “Cannot Verify AirPods” during pairing. This is a clear indication between fake AirPods Pro vs. real. 

Sound Quality and ANC Test 

If you have somehow connected your AirPods to your iPhone, move to the next steps to ensure you’re getting the premium features and luxury of an Apple product.

10. Audio Experience 

AirPods Pro are known for their rich sound and crisp vocals. Pop in the earbuds and play a song with a good mix of highs and lows (I like testing with something like Billie Eilish or The Weeknd).  

Fakes often sound flat, with weak bass or muddy vocals. If the music feels like it’s coming from a $10 pair of earbuds, you’re not dealing with the real thing. 

11. Active Noise Cancellation 

Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) is a standout feature of AirPods Pro. Turn it on and listen in a noisy environment—like a busy café or near a fan. Real ANC blocks out most background noise, creating a quiet bubble. You can also enable Noise Cancellation from Settings > Bluetooth > your AirPods Pro. 

Fakes either have no ANC or fake it with a hissing sound or muffled audio. Your AirPods Pro are likely counterfeit if you can still clearly hear your surroundings. 

iOS Features and Compatibility 

Apple AirPods Pro are known for their advanced features and smooth integration with iPhone.  

12. Feature Verification 

Real AirPods Pro unlock a bunch of neat features in iOS. Connect them to your iPhone and check the Bluetooth settings. You should see options for: 

  • Personal spatial audio with Dolby Atmos and head tracking for an immersive experience. 
  • Transparency mode allows you to hear your surroundings without removing the earbuds. 
  • Find My AirPods helps you track your earbuds if they’re lost. 
  • An ear tip fit test is performed to ensure the ear tips are the right size for your ears. 
  • Hearing Test and clinical-grade Hearing Aid support. 
  • Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness, and Personalized Volume 
  • Gesture options to answer calls, mute and unmute, and end calls. 

If these AirPods Pro settings are missing or don’t work, your AirPods Pro is probably fake. 

Price and Purchase Source 

When you buy from a third-party reseller, the risk of getting counterfeit AirPods Pro is higher. So, proceed with caution and keep the points below in mind. 

13. Too-Good-To-Be-True Deals 

The AirPods Pro retails for around $249, and Apple rarely offers deep discounts. While you may get older models for less, the latest ones are pricey. 

Therefore, if you see a new pair for $100, it’s almost certainly fake. Even during sales, legitimate discounts are usually 10-20% off. If the price seems like a steal, it’s probably a scam. 

14. Choose a Reputable Seller

Where you buy matters. Stick to Apple’s official store, authorized resellers like Best Buy or Amazon’s official Apple storefront, or certified refurbished programs.

Avoid sketchy websites, random eBay or Facebook sellers, or street vendors. If the seller’s reviews are nonexistent or scream “scam,” run the other way. 

Firmware Version and Updates 

This trick is ideal if you are using the AirPods and want to check its authenticity. 

15. Update Functionality 

Apple regularly updates the firmware of Real AirPods Pro to address bugs and roll out new features. Connect them to your iPhone, go to Settings > Bluetooth and tap the “i” next to your AirPods Pro. You’ll see the current AirPods firmware version.  

If it’s outdated and never updates (even after charging and pairing), or if it shows a bizarre version number, you’ve got a fake. 

Microphone and Call Quality Test 

AirPods Pro are great for calls, with clear audio and minimal background noise. 

16. Phone Call Test 

Make a test call to a friend and ask how you sound. Real AirPods Pro keeps your voice crisp, even in a noisy place. Counterfeit AirPods often pick up too much background noise or sound echo-like you’re talking in a tunnel. 

Build Material and Finish Quality 

Counterfeit AirPods Pro retail for cheap as they use inferior materials, so it’s a good hint.

17. Touch and Feel 

Run your fingers over the AirPods Pro and their case. Apple’s build quality is flawless—smooth surfaces, no gaps, and a premium feel. The grilles on the original AirPods Pro do not feature a boundary around the diffusers. 

Furthermore, the grills in a fake AirPod are well-polished, which is not the case in a real one. If it feels like a cheap toy with plasticky texture, visible seams, or rough edges, it’s not from Apple. 

Accessory and Documentation Review 

Check what’s in the box. Real AirPods Pro come with: 

  • MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C) with speaker and lanyard loop 
  • Silicone ear tips (four sizes: XS, S, M, L) 
  • USB-C Charge Cable 
  • Documentation includes a manual in multiple languages, a warranty card, and a safety sheet. 

Fakes might include flimsy manuals or generic cables that look off. 

Barcode and Label Scanning 

Most AirPods Pro boxes have a barcode or QR code. Use a QR code reader app to scan it. A real code should link to an Apple website or product page. It’s likely a fake if it leads to a random site, nothing at all, or a non-Apple domain. 

Real-Life Testing Techniques 

If you’re still unsure, compare your AirPods Pro to a friend’s genuine pair. Test the sound, check the ear tip fit, and inspect the case. Real AirPods Pro feel comfortable and sounds amazing. Fakes often feel off—maybe the ear tips don’t seal right, or the case creaks. Trust your senses. 

Bonus: Expert Advice and Community Forums 

Want more help? You can take your AirPods to an Apple Store for physical inspection. If that’s not feasible, YouTube has tons of videos comparing real vs. fake AirPods Pro—search for it to see the differences up close.  

Moreover, forums like Reddit or Apple’s support community is a goldmine for tips. Post a question or compare your serial number to see what others say. 

What to Do If You Bought a Fake Pair of AirPods Pro 

If you realize you’ve been scammed, don’t panic. Follow the steps below: 

  • Try to return it: If you bought it recently, contact the seller or the platform (like Amazon or eBay) for a refund. Many offer buyer protection. 
  • Report it: You can report counterfeit products to Apple here and also to your payment provider (like PayPal or your credit card company) to flag it as fraud. 
  • Warn others: Leave reviews on the seller’s page or post your story on Reddit and forums. You might save someone else from being scammed.  

Spot the Fake AirPods Pro Before They Fool You!

It’s easy to get tricked by fake AirPods Pro — some counterfeits are very convincing. But with this guide, you now know what to look for. Take your time inspecting the box, the product, the sound, and the features. And if something feels off, trust your gut. 

Have you ever dealt with a counterfeit product? Share your story in the comments—I’d love to hear how you handled it! 

FAQs

Can fake AirPods Pro connect to an iPhone?

Yes, many fakes can connect via Bluetooth, but the pairing process is often clunky, and you won’t get Apple’s smooth animation or iOS features. 

Do fake AirPods Pro support “Find My”?

Usually not. Real AirPods Pro integrates with Apple’s Find My network. If this feature is missing, it’s a strong sign of a fake. 

Can I update firmware on fake AirPods Pro?

Nope. Fakes either don’t update at all or show fake firmware versions that don’t match Apple’s records.

Are all fake AirPods Pro terrible in quality?

Not always. Some high-end fakes mimic the look and sound decently, but they still lack Apple’s polish, features, and reliability. 

How can I avoid buying a fake pair?

Buy from trusted sources like Apple, Best Buy, or Amazon’s official store. Avoid deals that seem too good to be true, and always check the serial number.

mainEntity.name: Can fake AirPods Pro connect to an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many fakes can connect via Bluetooth, but the pairing process is often clunky, and you won’t get Apple’s smooth animation or iOS features.

mainEntity.name: Do fake AirPods Pro support “Find My”?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Real AirPods Pro integrates with Apple’s Find My network. If this feature is missing, it’s a strong sign of a fake.

mainEntity.name: Can I update firmware on fake AirPods Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope. Fakes either don’t update at all or show fake firmware versions that don’t match Apple’s records.

mainEntity.name: Are all fake AirPods Pro terrible in quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Some high-end fakes mimic the look and sound decently, but they still lack Apple’s polish, features, and reliability.

mainEntity.name: How can I avoid buying a fake pair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buy from trusted sources like Apple, Best Buy, or Amazon’s official store. Avoid deals that seem too good to be true, and always check the serial number.

keyPoints.title: Why Checking for Fake AirPods Pro Is Important
keyPoints.explanation: Identifying authentic AirPods Pro helps protect your health, wallet, and privacy, as fakes may have poor materials, no warranty, and support illegal markets.

keyPoints.title: Inspect Packaging and Box Details
keyPoints.explanation: Genuine AirPods Pro come in high-quality, well-printed boxes with accurate fonts and no spelling errors, while fakes often feel cheap with dull colors and mistakes.

keyPoints.title: Verify Serial Number and Compatibility
keyPoints.explanation: Use Apple’s official serial number checker to confirm authenticity; fake serials may be invalid or already activated by others.

keyPoints.title: Examine Physical and Technical Features
keyPoints.explanation: Real AirPods Pro have specific dimensions, weight, LED lights, sensor functions, and build quality that fakes often cannot replicate accurately.

keyPoints.title: Assess Firmware, Compatibility, and Additional Features

title.rendered: Instagram Parental Controls: How to Set Up Supervision and Keep Your Teen Safe

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Instagram’s parental controls live in Meta’s Family Center, letting parents set time limits, track activity, and review interactions while respecting teen privacy.
  • Teen accounts come with built-in protections, including private profiles, strict message limits, restricted tagging, and high sensitivity content filters by default.
  • Supervision tools show parents activity insights, like time spent, followers, blocked users, messaging stats, and reports made, without giving full access to messages.
  • To set up supervision, invite your teen through Family Center, and both parent and teen must accept before controls are activated.
  • Parents can remove supervision anytime, but open discussions on online safety and trust help balance monitoring with independence.

In today’s digital world, teens spend hours scrolling through social media, and as a parent, it’s natural to be concerned. Instagram’s parental controls and Family Center tools give you peace of mind by allowing you to monitor your teen’s activity, manage screen time, and encourage healthy app habits—all while respecting their privacy.

In this guide, I’ll walk you through how to set up Instagram parental controls, what features are available, and how to use them effectively.

Table of Contents
  • What Are Instagram's Parental Control Features?
  • How Teen Accounts Work on Instagram
  • What Parents Can See With Instagram Supervision
  • Requirements to Set Up Instagram Supervision
  • How to Set Up Instagram Parental Controls
  • How Teens Can Accept the Instagram Supervision Invite
  • Monitor Your Teen’s Instagram Activity and Set Time Limits
    • 1. Monitor time spent
    • 2. Set daily time limits
    • 3. Sleep mode
  • How to Remove Instagram Supervision
  • Tips for Parents to Build Trust and Ensure Safety
  • Keep Your Teen Safe With Instagram Supervision

What Are Instagram’s Parental Control Features?

Instagram’s parental supervision tools are built into Meta’s Family Center, offering insights and management tools for connected apps like Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger.

Key features include:

  • Daily time limits and scheduled breaks
  • Notifications when your teen reports something
  • Overview of accounts followed, blocked, and messaging activity (no access to message content)
  • Privacy and content sensitivity settings overview

These tools are designed to strike a balance between safety and independence.

How Teen Accounts Work on Instagram

Instagram automatically applies extra safeguards to accounts of users aged 13–17:

  • Teen accounts are private by default
  • Messaging and tagging is restricted to mutual followers
  • High sensitivity filters are on by default
  • Teens need permission to go Live
  • Sleep mode silences notifications between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m.

What Parents Can See With Instagram Supervision

Once supervision is set up, you’ll be able to view:

Requirements to Set Up Instagram Supervision

  • You must be 18+ with your own Instagram account
  • Your teen must be aged 13–17 and follow you on Instagram
  • Both you and your teen need the latest Instagram version
  • Supervision begins only after your teen accepts the invite

How to Set Up Instagram Parental Controls

  1. Open the Instagram app on your phone and go to your profile by tapping your picture in the bottom right.
  2. Tap the three horizontal lines in the top right corner to access settings.
  3. Scroll down and select Family Center.
  4. Tap Get Started to proceed.

  5. Select your teen’s account and tap Invite to send a supervision request.
  6. If you and your teen don’t follow each other on Instagram, tap share a link instead at the top.
  7. It’ll show an invite link and pop up the Share Sheet. Send the link to your teen via email or text.

Your teen will receive a notification to accept the invite which is only valid for 7 days. Once accepted, supervision is active, and you can adjust settings from the Family Center.

Note If you want to supervise multiple accounts, repeat the process. However, you can send one active invitation link at a time.

To resend the invite: Go to Family Center > Tap your teen’s name > Resend Invite.

How Teens Can Accept the Instagram Supervision Invite

Teens need to accept the supervision invite to enable parental controls. Here’s how they can do it:

  1. Open the Instagram app and check for a notification about the supervision invite.
  2. Tap the invite and review the details, which explain what parents can see and control.
  3. Scroll down and tap Allow to enable supervision or Decline invitation to reject it.
  4. If the invite was sent via email or text, click the link and follow the prompts to log into Instagram and accept.

Teens should talk to their parents before accepting to understand expectations. Supervision is automatically removed when the teen turns 18.

Monitor Your Teen’s Instagram Activity and Set Time Limits

The Family Center lets parents track their teen’s activity and manage screen time:

1. Monitor time spent

View the total time your teen has spent on Instagram in the last seven days from Family Center. Select your teen account and go to Their time spent.

To get a more detailed report, scroll to Time on Instagram. Here, you will see how much your teen has used the app each day of the past week.

2. Set daily time limits

Limit how long your teen can use Instagram each day. By default, Instagram shows a reminder to take a break after the teen has spent one hour across a day.

Go to Family Center, select your teen’s account, and tap Time management. Set a time under Daily limit and tap Save. Select between Remind teen to close Instagram (they can still use it after time reached) or Block teen from Instagram so they can’t access the app at all.

Your teen can request for additional time. To grant it, go to your teen account from Family Center, scroll down to Requests, and tap See request. Now, choose the amount of time you want to give or select Remove time limit for today. Finally, tap Approve request.

Now, your teen can use Instagram for the additional time limit throughout the day. Note that if you don’t approve the additional time request, it expires automatically at midnight.

3. Sleep mode

Mute Instagram notifications and remind users to close the app during specific hours or days of the week, like bedtime or study time. By default, it’s set from 22:00 to 7:00 every day.

To change it, access your teen account from Family Center, tap Time management, and select the preset time period or day under Sleep mode. Once done, tap Save.

These tools can help support healthy habits, but parents should set limitations with their teens to ensure they are just and reasonable.

How to Remove Instagram Supervision

Parents:

  1. From your profile, go to Settings > Family Center.
  2. Select your teen’s account and tap Remove supervision.
  3. Confirm the action. Your teen will be notified, and supervision will end.

Teens:

  • Can request removal, which the parent must approve.
Note Supervision ends automatically when your teen turns 18.

Tips for Parents to Build Trust and Ensure Safety

To make the most of Instagram’s parental controls and keep your teen safe:

  • Discuss online safety with your teen, explaining why supervision is in place and encouraging them to share concerns.
  • Review your teen’s activity in the Family Center weekly to stay informed about their interactions.
  • Teach your teen to recognize harmful content, scams, or suspicious accounts and report them.
  • If your teen uses Snapchat, YouTube, or TikTok, explore their parental controls for consistent supervision.
  • Instagram’s features evolve, so check the Family Center for new tools or resources.
  • Balance monitoring with trust to avoid making your teen feel overly controlled.

These steps foster a collaborative approach to online safety.

Keep Your Teen Safe With Instagram Supervision

Instagram’s parental controls offer a smart way to help your teen explore social media safely while building trust between you both. With features like time limits, privacy insights, and usage reports, you’re empowered to guide their experience without hovering.

Still have questions? Drop them in the comments—I’m here to help!

FAQs

Can I read my teen’s private messages?

No, but you can see who they’ve messaged in the past week.

Can my teen turn off parental controls?

Not without your approval. Supervision automatically ends at age 18.

  • Best parental control apps for iPhone and iPad
  • What happens when you restrict someone on Instagram
  • How to use Instagram Notes

@graph.name: How to Set Up Instagram Parental Controls
@graph.description: Enable supervision features on Instagram to monitor and manage your teen’s account using Family Center.

step.name: Access your Instagram profile
step.text: Open the Instagram app and go to your profile by tapping your picture at the bottom right.

itemListElement.text: Open the Instagram app on your phone and go to your profile by tapping your picture in the bottom right.

step.name: Navigate to Family Center
step.text: Tap the three horizontal lines at the top right and scroll down to find Family Center in the menu.

itemListElement.text: Tap the three horizontal lines in the top right corner to access settings.
Scroll down and select Family Center.

step.name: Start supervision setup
step.text: Tap Get Started to begin setting up parental controls.

itemListElement.text: Tap Get Started to proceed.

step.name: Invite your teen
step.text: Choose your teen’s account and tap Invite to send a supervision request.

itemListElement.text: Select your teen’s account and tap Invite to send a supervision request.

step.name: Share supervision link if not connected
step.text: If you’re not following each other, tap Share a link instead to send the invite manually.

itemListElement.text: If you and your teen don’t follow each other on Instagram, tap share a link instead at the top.
It’ll show an invite link and pop up the Share Sheet. Send the link to your teen via email or text.

@graph.name: How Teens Can Accept the Instagram Supervision Invite
@graph.description: Teens can easily accept or decline Instagram parental supervision invites directly in the app or through a shared link.

step.name: Check for the supervision invite
step.text: Open the Instagram app and look for a notification about the parental supervision invite.

itemListElement.text: Open the Instagram app and check for a notification about the supervision invite.

step.name: Review supervision details
step.text: Tap the invite to see details about what parents can view and control.

itemListElement.text: Tap the invite and review the details, which explain what parents can see and control.

step.name: Accept or decline supervision
step.text: Scroll down and either tap Allow to accept or Decline invitation if you don’t want supervision.

itemListElement.text: Scroll down and tap Allow to enable supervision or Decline invitation to reject it.

step.name: Accept via shared link (optional)
step.text: If the invite was shared by email or text, click the link, log in to Instagram, and follow the prompts to accept.

itemListElement.text: If the invite was sent via email or text, click the link and follow the prompts to log into Instagram and accept.

keyPoints.title: Instagram's Parental Control Features within Meta's Family Center
keyPoints.explanation: These tools allow parents to monitor activity, set time limits, and view account interactions to help guide their teen's social media use while respecting privacy.

keyPoints.title: How Teen Accounts are Managed on Instagram
keyPoints.explanation: Instagram applies default safety measures to teen accounts, including privacy settings, restrictions on messaging and tagging, and default high sensitivity filters.

keyPoints.title: Parents' View of Teen Activity with Supervision Tools
keyPoints.explanation: Supervision features enable parents to see messaging activity, follower lists, blocked accounts, time spent, and reports made by their teen, enhancing oversight while maintaining privacy.

keyPoints.title: Steps to Set Up Instagram Parental Controls
keyPoints.explanation: Parents can start supervision through the Family Center in the app, invite their teen to join, and both parties need to accept the supervision invitation for it to activate.

keyPoints.title: Managing and Removing Supervision and Tips for Building Trust
keyPoints.explanation: Parents can remove supervision at any time, and it's important to discuss online safety with teens, review activity regularly, and balance monitoring with trust for a healthy relationship.

title.rendered: How to Fix the “iMessage is Signed Out” Error on an iPhone: A Complete Guide

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Check Apple’s System Status first, since iMessage errors can stem from server outages rather than issues with your iPhone.
  • Verify your internet connection is stable, switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data or restarting your router if websites fail to load.
  • Toggle iMessage off and back on in Settings, which refreshes the service and clears temporary glitches causing sign-out problems.
  • Re-sign into your Apple ID in Settings, as account authentication issues often trigger repeated iMessage disconnections.
  • Update iOS and enable automatic Date & Time, ensuring your device stays compatible with iMessage and avoids sync errors.

The ‘iMessage is Signed Out’ error is a frustrating issue that keeps baffling many iPhone users. Put simply, it prevents you from sending and receiving messages through iMessage, pushing your conversations back to regular SMS.

Fortunately, you can fix the issue in a few easy steps. Let’s understand why the “iMessage is Signed Out” error pops up and look at all the effective solutions to troubleshoot it on an iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Why Causes the “iMessage is Signed Out” Error on an iPhone?
  • 9 Ways to Fix the "iMessage is Signed Out" Error on an iPhone
    • 1. Check Apple's System Status
    • 2. Check Your Internet Connection
    • 3. Toggle iMessage Off and On
    • 4. Sign Out and Back Into Apple Account
    • 5. Set the Date & Time Setting to Automatic
    • 6. Disable VPN
    • 7. Restart Your iPhone
    • 8. Reset the Network Settings
    • 9. Update iOS
  • Back in Blue: iMessage Restored and Ready

Why Causes the “iMessage is Signed Out” Error on an iPhone? 

You may see the “iMessage is Signed Out” error on your iPhone due to one or more of the following reasons:

  • Authentication issue with your Apple Account
  • Network problems or unstable internet
  • Incorrect date and time settings
  • Apple’s iMessage servers being temporarily down
  • Bugs introduced by an iOS update

9 Ways to Fix the “iMessage is Signed Out” Error on an iPhone

From checking Apple’s system status to verifying your internet connection to refreshing the iMessage services, below are all the tried-and-tested solutions to help you get iMessage working again on your iPhone.

1. Check Apple’s System Status

Before you try to fix the issue on your side, it’s important to verify whether the problem lies with your device or Apple since iMessage servers occasionally go down for maintenance or experience outages. To do this:

  1. Visit Apple’s System Status page. 
  2. Look for the iMessage service status. If it’s red, there’s an issue with iMessage servers.

In this case, wait for Apple to resolve the issue, as there’s nothing you can do on your end. However, if the iMessage status is green, move to the solutions below.

2. Check Your Internet Connection

Unlike regular SMS, iMessage requires your iPhone to have a stable internet connection, whether cellular or Wi-Fi. A poor Wi-Fi signal or poor cellular network reception can cause the ‘iMessage is Signed Out’ error.

To check whether your iPhone’s internet is working, open Safari and try to access any website. If it doesn’t load and Safari displays the “iPhone is not connected to the internet” message, You’ve likely found the cause of the error.

You can try the following to fix it:

  • Try switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data
  • Restart your router if you’re on Wi-Fi
  • Toggle Airplane Mode on and off

3. Toggle iMessage Off and On

If the internet and Apple’s iMessage servers are working fine, but the issue persists, refreshing the iMessage services on your iPhone can force your iPhone to reestablish the connection with Apple’s servers. Simply turning iMessage off and on again can clear minor glitches that might be causing a disconnection. Here’s how to do it:

  1. Open Settings and go to Apps > Messages.
  2. Toggle off the iMessage button.
  3. Wait a few seconds, then toggle it on again.

4. Sign Out and Back Into Apple Account

Sometimes, an authentication issue with your Apple Account can disrupt the regular functioning of iMessage. To fix this, try signing out and back into your Apple Account, as this can reestablish a fresh connection with Apple’s servers.

  1. Open Settings and tap your Apple Account name at the top.
  2. Scroll down to the bottom and tap the Sign Out button. 

  3. Enter your Apple Account password to confirm.
  4. Wait a few seconds and sign back in.

5. Set the Date & Time Setting to Automatic

A mismatch between the date and time on your iPhone and that of Apple’s servers can affect network-related functions like FaceTime and iMessage. So, head to the Date & Time settings and verify if your iPhone follows the correct time zone.

  1. In Settings, navigate to General > Date and Time. 
  2. Toggle on Set Automatically.

6. Disable VPN

Having VPN enabled on your iPhone can affect iMessage’s ability to connect to Apple’s servers. This is because some VPNs block certain ports or reroute traffic in a way that prevents iMessage from authenticating correctly. Disabling VPN might restore proper functioning.

You can disable the VPN by going into Settings > VPN and flipping the VPN Status toggle off. Alternatively, you may head back into the VPN app and turn off the connection directly by tapping the Disconnect or equivalent button.

7. Restart Your iPhone

If Apple’s servers are working fine, or there isn’t any issue with your Apple Account or Date & Time setting on your iPhone, a software bug or glitch might be the reason behind the “iMessage is Signed Out” error.

While you can’t identify the software bug or glitch, you can restart your iPhone, and it should do the trick—like it does with many issues.

8. Reset the Network Settings

Sometimes, your iPhone might have trouble connecting to the internet, causing iMessage to keep signing you out. It’s not very common, but it’s worth checking out, and the best way to fix it is to reset your iPhone’s network settings. However, this will erase all the saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords, Bluetooth devices, and VPN information, so note them somewhere safe beforehand.

  1. Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone.

  2. Tap Reset, then choose Reset Network Settings and follow the on-screen instructions.

9. Update iOS

An outdated iOS version can cause performance-related issues on your iPhone and prevent built-in apps and services from working properly. Apple often releases iOS updates with security patches and bug fixes to fix bugs and improve performance. Here’s how you can check if an update is available and install it:

  1. Head to Settings > General > Software Update.
  2. If an update is available, tap Download and Install and perform the on-screen prompts.

Back in Blue: iMessage Restored and Ready

While the “iMessage is Signed Out” error can be disruptive, the solutions we’ve shared above should help you fix it. However, if none of them works and you still keep seeing the error, contact Apple Support, as their experts should be able to identify the problem and offer personalized assistance to get iMessage working again.

keyPoints.title: Check Apple's System Status
keyPoints.explanation: Before troubleshooting on your device, verify if the iMessage servers are operational by visiting Apple's System Status page, as outages can cause the error.

keyPoints.title: Ensure a Stable Internet Connection
keyPoints.explanation: iMessage requires a reliable internet connection, so test your network by loading a website; switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data or restart your router if needed.

keyPoints.title: Refresh iMessage Services
keyPoints.explanation: Toggle iMessage off and on in Settings to reset the connection and clear minor glitches that might be causing the sign-out issue.

keyPoints.title: Reauthenticate Your Apple Account
keyPoints.explanation: Sign out and back into your Apple ID in Settings to resolve potential authentication problems affecting iMessage.

keyPoints.title: Update iOS and Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Keep your iPhone updated with the latest iOS version and set Date & Time to automatic to avoid compatibility and synchronization issues.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How to Change Reddit Username: Best Tips and Practical Steps

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Reddit usernames can only be changed within 30 days, usually if auto-assigned at signup or when registering with Apple ID. After that, they’re permanent.
  • If the 30-day window has passed, you must create a new account, since old usernames can’t be reused or altered once locked in.
  • On mobile, tap your profile to check for “Change Username,” while desktop users will find the option under profile settings—only visible during the 30-day period.
  • Usernames differ from display names, which you can edit anytime for personalization without affecting your login credentials.
  • Username changes are one-time, irreversible, and restricted, requiring 3–23 characters; once you post or comment, your username is locked permanently.

Wondering how to change your Reddit username? It’s not as simple as it seems, but don’t worry—I’m here to guide you. Reddit is a popular forum, but its username policy can be confusing for both new and longtime users. If you’re asking, “Can I change my Reddit username?” or want to update your profile, this guide covers it all. Whether you have a randomly assigned username or want a fresh start, I’ve got you covered!

In this guide, I’ll explain Reddit’s username rules and show you practical steps to change your username or create a new account if needed. Plus, I’ll clarify the difference between your Reddit username and display name, so you can customize your presence just the way you want. Whether you’re a casual browser or a frequent poster, understanding these details will help you manage your Reddit identity like a pro.

Table of Contents
  • Can You Change Your Reddit Username?
  • Changing a Randomly Assigned Reddit Username
  • How to Change Your Username on Reddit Desktop
  • Changing Reddit Username on iPhone and Android
  • Creating a New Reddit Account
  • Switching Between Multiple Reddit Accounts
  • Changing Your Reddit Display Name
  • Things to Know Before Changing Your Username
  • Changing Your Reddit Username Made Easy

Can You Change Your Reddit Username?

The short answer is: it depends. Reddit has specific rules about username changes based on how you signed up and how long you’ve had your account. New users who signed up with a Google or Apple ID often receive a randomly assigned username, which can be changed within 30 days. After this period, or if you signed up with an email address, the username becomes permanent.

If you want a different username after this window, you’ll need to create a new account. Keep in mind that once a username is set, it cannot be reused, even if the original account is deleted.

Changing a Randomly Assigned Reddit Username

If you have a randomly assigned username and are within the 30-day window, you can change it easily. On the Reddit app:

  1. Tap your profile icon.
  2. Select ‘My Profile‘.
  3. Look for the ‘Change Username’ option.
  4. Enter a new username between 3 and 23 characters.
  5. Confirm the change when prompted.

Remember, this is a one-time, irreversible change.

How to Change Your Username on Reddit Desktop

To change your username on your desktop:

  1. Sign in to your Reddit account.
  2. From the Reddit home page, click your username or profile avatar in the top-right corner.
  3. If available, select ‘Change Username’ from the drop-down menu.
  4. Enter your desired new username (3 to 23 characters).
  5. Confirm and save your new username.

If the option isn’t visible, your account is not eligible to change its username.

Changing Reddit Username on iPhone and Android

On the Reddit mobile app:

  1. Open the app and sign in.
  2. Tap the profile icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Go to your profile page.
  4. Tap ‘Change Username’ if available.

  5. Enter and confirm your new username.

Your username will update immediately after confirmation.

Creating a New Reddit Account

If you can’t change your username, creating a new account is the alternative:

  1. Log out of your current Reddit account.
  2. Click ‘Sign Up’ on the Reddit home page.
  3. Sign up using an email address, Google, or Apple ID.
  4. Choose a unique username during sign-up.
  5. Verify your email to activate the account.

This allows you to start fresh while keeping your old account intact if desired.

Switching Between Multiple Reddit Accounts

Managing multiple Reddit accounts is easy:

  1. Log out of one account to log into another.
  2. Use the same email address for multiple accounts.
  3. Switch between accounts without deleting any.

Changing Your Reddit Display Name

Your display name is different from your username and can be changed anytime:

  1. Open the Reddit app.
  2. Tap your profile icon.
  3. Tap on profile

  4. Edit your display name.
  5. Save changes.

This updates your profile appearance without affecting your username.

Things to Know Before Changing Your Username

  1. The 30-day window to change a randomly assigned username is strict.
  2. Once you post or comment, you can no longer change your username.
  3. New usernames must be unique and 3 to 23 characters long.
  4. Username changes are one-time and irreversible.

Changing Your Reddit Username Made Easy

Changing your Reddit username is possible only under specific conditions, mainly within 30 days of account creation if you have a randomly assigned username or signed up with an Apple ID. Otherwise, creating a new account is necessary. Your display name, however, can be changed at any time to personalize your profile.

FAQs

Can I change my Reddit username after creating my account?

Only within 30 days if it was randomly assigned or created with an Apple ID. Otherwise, no.

What happens if I miss the 30-day window to change my username?

You must create a new Reddit account to use a different username.

Can I reuse an old username if I delete my account?

No. Once a username is taken, it cannot be used again—even if the account is deleted.

Can I use the same email for multiple Reddit accounts?

Yes, Reddit allows multiple accounts under the same email.

Is changing my display name different from changing my username?

Yes, display names can be changed anytime, while usernames have restrictions.

Will my posts and karma transfer to a new account?

No. Each Reddit account is separate, and your activity does not carry over.

Related articles worth reading:

  • How to Change Your Snapchat Username
  • How to Change Your Facebook Username
  • How to Add Social Media Profiles to iPhone Contacts

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many fakes can connect via Bluetooth, but the pairing process is often clunky, and you won’t get Apple’s smooth animation or iOS features.

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Real AirPods Pro integrates with Apple’s Find My network. If this feature is missing, it’s a strong sign of a fake.

mainEntity.name: Can I update firmware on fake AirPods Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope. Fakes either don’t update at all or show fake firmware versions that don’t match Apple’s records.

mainEntity.name: Are all fake AirPods Pro terrible in quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Some high-end fakes mimic the look and sound decently, but they still lack Apple’s polish, features, and reliability.

mainEntity.name: How can I avoid buying a fake pair?

mainEntity.name: Can I change my Reddit username after creating my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only within 30 days if it was randomly assigned or created with an Apple ID. Otherwise, no.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I miss the 30-day window to change my username?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must create a new Reddit account to use a different username.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once a username is taken, it cannot be used again—even if the account is deleted.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same email for multiple Reddit accounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Reddit allows multiple accounts under the same email.

mainEntity.name: Is changing my display name different from changing my username?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Each Reddit account is separate, and your activity does not carry over.

keyPoints.title: Limited Time to Change a Reddit Username
keyPoints.explanation: You can only change your Reddit username within 30 days if it was randomly assigned or if you signed up with an Apple ID; after that, it becomes permanent.

keyPoints.title: Creating a New Account as an Alternative
keyPoints.explanation: If the 30-day window has passed or your account was created with an email, you need to create a new account to use a different username, as previous usernames cannot be reused.

keyPoints.title: How to Change Your Usernames on Mobile and Desktop
keyPoints.explanation: Changing your username on mobile involves accessing your profile and selecting 'Change Username' if available, while on desktop, this option can be found in your profile settings.

keyPoints.title: Display Name vs. Username
keyPoints.explanation: Your display name is separate from your username and can be changed at any time, allowing for profile personalization without affecting your account login.

keyPoints.title: Important Rules and Restrictions
keyPoints.explanation: Username changes are one-time and irreversible, and usernames must be 3 to 23 characters long; after posting or commenting, your username cannot be changed.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: How to Customize Individual Apps on iPhone Using Per-App Settings

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What Per-App Settings do on iPhone: Apple’s Per-App Settings let you customize accessibility features like text size, contrast, and motion for individual apps instead of changing the whole system.
  • Why Per-App Settings matter: You can keep default system preferences while tailoring specific apps for easier reading, reduced eye strain, or smoother navigation depending on your needs.
  • How to enable Per-App Settings: Go to Settings > Accessibility > Per-App Settings, choose an app, then tweak features such as bold text, dark mode, or reduced animations.
  • What customization options exist: Adjustments include larger text, button shapes, higher contrast, motion reduction, and media playback choices that only apply to selected apps.
  • Precautions when using Per-App Settings: Some third-party apps may ignore changes, so limit customization to key apps and combine with Focus Modes for consistent results.

Your iPhone is packed with accessibility tools, but most of them affect the entire system. If you increase text size, every app gets bigger, even the ones you don’t want. That’s where Per-App Settings come in. This feature lets you fine-tune how individual apps look and behave without touching the rest of your phone.

Imagine Messages with bold text and high contrast while Instagram stays clean and minimal. That’s the magic of Per-App Settings.

What Are Per-App Settings on iPhone?

Per-App Settings is an accessibility feature in iOS and iPadOS. It lets you apply specific visual and motion settings to individual apps, rather than system-wide. Apple first introduced this feature with iOS 15, and over time, it’s only gotten better with more customization options. In iOS 18, Apple even added new tweaks like controlling cursor blink and showing hidden apps.

Think of it as your personal toolkit. You can:

  • Increase text size in Mail, but keep it standard in X (Twitter).
  • Force Smart Invert in apps that don’t support Dark Mode.
  • Add shapes to buttons so they’re easier to spot.
  • Reduce animations in just one app without slowing down your whole device.

Why Use Per-App Settings?

The power lies in personalization. Everyone uses their iPhone differently. With Per-App Settings, you can:

  • Personalize reading apps: Make Kindle text larger, but keep Notes clean and compact.
  • Boost accessibility: Adjust contrast or enable bold text for just the apps that feel hard to read.
  • Stay productive: Work apps can be set up with sharper text and less motion, while entertainment apps stay visually rich.
  • Help family members: Kids or elderly users can have apps tuned for readability without altering the whole device.

It’s all about giving you the control Apple usually keeps locked down.

How to Enable Per-App Settings on iPhone

Getting started is simple. Here’s how:

  1. Open Settings and tap Accessibility.
  2. Scroll down and select Per-App Settings.
  3. Tap Add App and pick the app you want to customize.
  4. Once added, tap the app’s name in the list.
  5. Choose the settings you want to adjust (like Bold Text, Larger Text, Smart Invert).

That’s it. Open the app, and you’ll see the changes instantly. If not, force-quit the app or restart your iPhone. Just remember: some apps (like Spotify) don’t support all options.

Customization Options in Per-App Settings

When you add an app to Per-App Settings, you’ll see a list of options you can adjust. Not every app supports all of them, but the variety is impressive:

Text and Font Adjustments

  • Bold Text: Makes all text in the app thicker and easier to read.
  • Larger Text: Adjust font size with a slider just for that app.
  • Prefer Horizontal Text: Displays vertical text horizontally in some languages.
  • Prefer Non-Blinking Cursor (iOS 18+): Stops the text cursor from blinking, so it’s always visible.

Button and Toggle Options

  • Button Shapes: Adds outlines or underlines to text buttons so they look more like real buttons.
  • On/Off Labels: Puts clear “I” and “O” symbols on toggles.

Color and Contrast

  • Reduce Transparency: Cuts down on blurry backgrounds, improving legibility.
  • Increase Contrast: Boosts color separation between foreground and background.
  • Differentiate Without Color: Adds alternatives for elements that normally rely only on color.
  • Smart Invert: Flips colors like a pseudo-Dark Mode, but leaves images and videos untouched.

Motion and Animation

  • Reduce Motion: Tones down UI animations and parallax effects.
  • Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions: Smooths out transitions instead of sliding motions (only shows up when Reduce Motion is enabled).

Media Playback

  • Auto-Play Animated Images: Lets GIFs and Live Stickers play automatically.
  • Auto-Play Video Previews: Enables video previews in apps like the App Store.

Some settings can even affect performance or battery life. For example, disabling video previews may save data, while enabling them can drain it faster. It’s worth experimenting to see what works best for you.

Tips and Best Practices

  • Don’t overdo it. Pick apps that genuinely need extra readability or a custom look.
  • Combine with Focus Modes to create powerful setups (like work mode with toned-down animations).
  • Perfect for accessibility: kids, the elderly, or visually impaired users.
  • Remember, these settings sync with iCloud backup, so you don’t lose them when switching devices.

Troubleshooting Per-App Settings

  • Settings not showing: Make sure your iPhone is updated to the latest iOS.
  • Changes not applying: Close and reopen the app, or restart your iPhone.
  • Some apps ignore settings: Not all apps support every tweak (e.g., Spotify won’t bold text).
  • Reset easily: Go back to Per-App Settings, select the app, and hit Default or delete it from the list.

Personalization That Actually Works

Per-App Settings may not sound flashy, but it’s one of the smartest ways to make your iPhone fit you. Whether it’s making text easier to read in Mail, forcing dark mode in your favorite reader, or calming animations in one app without slowing down others, it’s all possible. Experiment with different tweaks, see what works for you, and enjoy a more personal iPhone experience.

FAQs

Do Per-App Settings work on all apps?

Not always. Some third-party apps don’t support every option.

Can I reset Per-App Settings to default?

Yes. Tap the app in the list and choose Default, or delete it entirely.

What’s the difference between Per-App Settings and Focus Mode?

Per-App Settings adjust how apps look and behave visually, while Focus Mode controls notifications and distractions.

Do Per-App Settings sync across devices?

Yes, if you use iCloud backup and restore.

  • How to use the Accessibility Shortcut on Apple Watch
  • How to use the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad

keyPoints.title: What Are Per-App Settings on iPhone?
keyPoints.explanation: Per-App Settings is an accessibility feature in iOS and iPadOS allowing users to customize visual and motion preferences for individual apps, enhancing personalization without system-wide changes.

keyPoints.title: Benefits of Using Per-App Settings
keyPoints.explanation: This feature enables personalized adjustments like increased text size, dark mode in specific apps, and reduced animations, tailored to different usage scenarios or user needs.

keyPoints.title: How to Enable Per-App Settings
keyPoints.explanation: You can activate Per-App Settings by navigating to Settings > Accessibility > Per-App Settings, then selecting and customizing individual apps with your preferred options.

keyPoints.title: Available Customization Options
keyPoints.explanation: Users can modify settings such as bold or larger text, button shapes, contrast levels, motion reduction, and media playback preferences for each app.

keyPoints.title: Tips for Effective Usage
keyPoints.explanation: To maximize benefits, select only essential apps for customization, combine with Focus Modes, and remember that some third-party apps might not support all settings.

title.rendered: How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on iPhone, Android, and Web for a Faster Experience

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Why X (Twitter) Builds Cache and Why You Should Clear It: X caches media and webpages for faster loading, but excessive buildup can slow performance, drain storage, and cause app glitches.
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on iPhone or iPad: You can clear cache only inside the X app under Media storage and Web storage, since iOS blocks system-wide cache clearing.
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Android: On Android, you can clear cache from system settings by opening app info, selecting Storage, and tapping Clear cache.
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Web Browsers: In browsers like Chrome or Firefox, clear all cached data in settings or just reset X cache using DevTools’ Empty Cache and Hard Reload.
  • What Happens After Clearing X Cache?: Cache clearing wipes temporary files but keeps tweets and account data intact, improving speed and freeing up valuable device storage.

If you use Twitter (or X, as it’s now called) every day, you’ve probably noticed the app slowing down over time. Maybe videos take forever to load, posts repeat themselves, or the app even crashes randomly. Most of the time, the culprit is that Twitter caches all the temporary data it stores on your phone to make things feel faster. But when that data piles up, it does the opposite.

The good news? Clearing your X (Twitter) cache gives the app a fresh start and frees up space on your device.

Table of Contents
  • Why X (Twitter) Builds Cache and Why You Should Clear It
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on iPhone or iPad
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Android
  • How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Web Browsers
    • Option 1: Clear Entire Browser Cache
    • Option 2: Clear Cache Just for Twitter
  • What Happens After Clearing X Cache?
  • Tips to Manage X Cache Better
  • Keep It Smooth: Make Cache Clearing a Habit

Why X (Twitter) Builds Cache and Why You Should Clear It

Every time you scroll through your feed, X saves images, videos, and web pages so they load quicker next time. That’s why you can sometimes view posts offline or instantly replay videos you’ve already seen.

But over time, this hidden storage balloons, slowing down the app, hogging storage, and even causing glitches. If you’ve been dealing with lag, outdated info, or crashes, it’s a sign your cache needs clearing.

How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on iPhone or iPad

Unlike Android, iOS doesn’t let you clear app cache from system settings. Luckily, Twitter has a built-in option:

  1. Open the Twitter (X) app and tap your profile picture in the top-left corner.
  2. Tap Settings and privacy.
  3. Go to Accessibility, display, and languages.
  4. Then tap on Data usage.
  5. At the bottom, tap Media storage and confirm Clear media storage twice.
  6. Back on the Data usage page, tap Web storage.
  7. Pick either Clear web page storage (keeps you logged in) or Clear all web storage (logs you out too). Confirm by tapping twice.

That’s it. You’ve just reset the app’s stored files. If you want Twitter to use less space in the future, you can also turn on the Data Saver option in the same menu. This reduces image quality and stops videos from autoplaying, but saves storage long term.

How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Android

Android makes things much simpler because you can wipe cache from system settings directly:

  1. Long-press the Twitter (X) app icon and select App info.
  2. Tap Storage or Storage usage.
  3. Tap Clear cache. If you need even more space, you can also tap Clear data, but that will reset the app entirely.

Cache is gone instantly, and the app will start loading fresh data the next time you open it.

How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Web Browsers

If you use X in Chrome, Safari, or Firefox, you’ll need to clear cache in your browser:

Option 1: Clear Entire Browser Cache

  1. Open your browser settings.
  2. Find the option for Privacy or Clear browsing data.
  3. Select Cached images and files and clear them.

Option 2: Clear Cache Just for Twitter

  1. Open Twitter in your browser.
  2. Right-click anywhere on the page and click Inspect (or press F12 / Cmd+Option+I) to open DevTools.
  3. Click-and-hold the Reload button (next to the address bar).
  4. Select Empty Cache and Hard Reload.
  5. This clears cache just for twitter.com and forces a fresh load.

This forces Twitter to load fresh content without affecting other sites.

What Happens After Clearing X Cache?

Clearing the cache doesn’t delete your tweets or account data. It simply resets temporary files so the app can start fresh again. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The app or browser reloads all content fresh.
  • Media and tweets may take slightly longer to load the first time.
  • Login details are usually not affected, unless you clear cookies on the web.
  • Benefits include a smoother app, updated content, and reduced storage usage.
  • Temporary files are deleted, freeing up space on your device.
  • It can fix issues like crashes, glitches, or excessive lag without affecting your personal data.
  • Clearing the cache does not log you out or reset your app settings; that only happens if you clear app data.
  • Core user data like login info, posts, account settings, and downloaded files remain untouched; only temporary files are removed.

Also Read: How to fix Twitter not working on iPhone or iPad?

Tips to Manage X Cache Better

Managing the cache is not just about clearing it once. With a few habits and settings, you can slow down how quickly it builds up and keep the app light and smooth.

  1. Clear the cache once every few weeks if you are a heavy user. This prevents the app from slowing down and keeps your phone responsive.
  2. Turn off Autoplay videos or limit media downloads to reduce how quickly cache builds up.
  3. Use Lite mode or enable Data Saver to save space, though this will lower image quality and stop videos from autoplaying.
  4. Keep your Twitter app updated regularly, since updates often include improvements that optimize cache handling.

Keep It Smooth: Make Cache Clearing a Habit

Clearing your Twitter (X) cache is one of the easiest ways to fix lag, glitches, or endless loading screens. Think of it as digital spring cleaning, it frees space, refreshes your feed, and makes the app feel brand new. Add it to your regular phone maintenance routine, just like deleting old photos or clearing your inbox.

Try it now, and enjoy a smoother, faster Twitter (X) experience.

FAQs

Will clearing cache delete my tweets or followers?

No, your tweets, followers, and account data stay intact. Only temporary files are removed.

Is clearing cache the same as deleting data?

No. Clearing cache removes temporary files, while deleting data resets the app and logs you out.

How often should I clear X cache?

Every few weeks, if you use the app daily, or whenever you notice lag or storage issues.

Why does the X app keep taking so much storage?

Because images, videos, and web data keep piling up in the cache. Clearing it regularly helps control storage use.

mainEntity.name: Can fake AirPods Pro connect to an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many fakes can connect via Bluetooth, but the pairing process is often clunky, and you won’t get Apple’s smooth animation or iOS features.

mainEntity.name: Do fake AirPods Pro support “Find My”?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Real AirPods Pro integrates with Apple’s Find My network. If this feature is missing, it’s a strong sign of a fake.

mainEntity.name: Can I update firmware on fake AirPods Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope. Fakes either don’t update at all or show fake firmware versions that don’t match Apple’s records.

mainEntity.name: Are all fake AirPods Pro terrible in quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Some high-end fakes mimic the look and sound decently, but they still lack Apple’s polish, features, and reliability.

mainEntity.name: How can I avoid buying a fake pair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buy from trusted sources like Apple, Best Buy, or Amazon’s official store. Avoid deals that seem too good to be true, and always check the serial number.

blockGraphs.question: Will clearing cache delete my tweets or followers?
blockGraphs.answer: No, your tweets, followers, and account data stay intact. Only temporary files are removed.

blockGraphs.question: Is clearing cache the same as deleting data?
blockGraphs.answer: No. Clearing cache removes temporary files, while deleting data resets the app and logs you out.

blockGraphs.question: How often should I clear X cache?
blockGraphs.answer: Every few weeks, if you use the app daily, or whenever you notice lag or storage issues.

blockGraphs.question: Why does the X app keep taking so much storage?
blockGraphs.answer: Because images, videos, and web data keep piling up in the cache. Clearing it regularly helps control storage use.

keyPoints.title: Why X (Twitter) Builds Cache and Why You Should Clear It
keyPoints.explanation: Twitter caches images, videos, and web pages to load content faster, but excessive cache can slow down the app, cause glitches, and hog storage.

keyPoints.title: How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on iPhone or iPad
keyPoints.explanation: On iOS, you can clear Twitter cache via the app by accessing settings like Media storage and Web storage, as i iOS doesn't allow system-wide cache clearing.

keyPoints.title: How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Android
keyPoints.explanation: Android users can clear Twitter cache directly through system settings by going to app info, storage, and selecting 'Clear cache' for an instant reset.

keyPoints.title: How to Clear X (Twitter) Cache on Web Browsers
keyPoints.explanation: In web browsers like Chrome or Firefox, cache can be cleared either entirely from browser settings or specifically for Twitter using DevTools' 'Empty Cache and Hard Reload'.

keyPoints.title: What Happens After Clearing X Cache?
keyPoints.explanation: Clearing cache resets temporary files without deleting tweets or account data, leading to a smoother app experience and freeing up device storage.
