acceptedAnswer.text: If you don't want to put your iPhone and Mac on Do Not Disturb together, go to System Settings → Focus and toggle off Share Across Devices. This ensures DND is managed independently on each device.

mainEntity.name: Why does Do Not Disturb keep turning on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your scheduled settings under System Settings → Focus → Do Not Disturb and ensure no automation is activating it unexpectedly.

mainEntity.name: Can my child disable Communication Safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, your child cannot disable Communication Safety if you have enabled it through Family Sharing and Screen Time parental controls. However, if your child knows your Screen Time passcode, they might be able to make changes.

mainEntity.name: Does Communication Safety work with third-party apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of the time of writing this, Communication Safety is restricted to the Apple ecosystem and does not work with third-party apps.

mainEntity.name: Does Communication Safety apply to all family members?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Communication Safety does not automatically apply to all family members. It's specifically designed for children under 18 who are part of a Family Sharing group.

keyPoints.title: Apple’s Massive U.S. Investment
keyPoints.explanation: Apple plans to invest $600 billion in U.S. manufacturing over four years, emphasizing its commitment to strengthening the local supply chain amid geopolitical shifts.

keyPoints.title: Introduction of the American Manufacturing Program (AMP)
keyPoints.explanation: AMP unites nine key tech manufacturing partners to enhance advanced production and innovation across the United States, reinforcing Apple’s domestic supply network.

keyPoints.title: Tim Cook on U.S. Manufacturing Commitment
keyPoints.explanation: Apple CEO Tim Cook highlights the company's increased investments in the U.S., focusing on collaborations with American companies to produce components used worldwide.

keyPoints.title: Corning’s $2.5 Billion Kentucky Expansion
keyPoints.explanation: Corning plans a $2.5 billion investment to expand its Kentucky glass production facility, enabling the manufacturing of iPhone and Apple Watch cover glass entirely in the U.S.

keyPoints.title: Strategic Shift in Global Supply Chain
keyPoints.explanation: Apple’s significant investment signals a strategic move to localize critical components, building resilience against disruptions and reducing reliance on overseas suppliers.

title.rendered: Now you can schedule messages on Instagram. Here’s how to do it

content.rendered:
Scheduling Direct Messages (DM) on Instagram can help you build relationships with friends and followers. It ensures you never miss out on anything important, such as sending birthday wishes or informing your followers about a scheduled post.

Keep reading to learn how to schedule DMs on Instagram and the associated benefits.

Table of Contents
  • How to schedule Instagram messages on iPhone
  • Manage scheduled messages on Instagram
    • See your scheduled messages
    • Immediately send a scheduled message
    • Cancel a scheduled message
  • Benefits of scheduling Instagram messages

How to schedule Instagram messages on iPhone

Scheduling a DM on Instagram is as easy as scheduling a text message. Let me show you how:

First and foremost, make sure the Instagram app on your iPhone is up to date.

  1. Open the Instagram app and swipe left on the home screen to enter the Direct Message section.
  2. Tap the Compose button at the top right corner to start a new conversation or open an existing one.
  3. Next, type in the text you want to schedule in the text field.
  4. Now, press and hold the Send button to access the message scheduling interface.
  5. Finally, select the date & time and hit the Send at [time] button.
  6. A scheduled message bar will appear above the text field.

  7. Repeat the same process to schedule any number of messages you want in a conversation.

Manage scheduled messages on Instagram

While the scheduled messages will be automatically sent at their set time, you might want to recheck for spelling mistakes, send it immediately, or delete it altogether for some reason or another.

See your scheduled messages

  1. Open the Direct Message conversation in which you previously scheduled messages.
  2. Here, tap on scheduled messages above the text field.
  3. Next, all the scheduled messages for the particular conversation will appear along with the time & date they are scheduled for.

Immediately send a scheduled message

  1. Once you are on the scheduled messages screen, tap and hold the scheduled message you want to send immediately.
  2. Next, tap Send Now on the pop-up menu that appears.

Cancel a scheduled message

Sadly, Instagram does not allow you to edit a scheduled message; you must delete it if there is a typo or spelling error. Here’s how:

  1. Tap and hold the scheduled message you want to delete.
  2. Tap Delete when the pop-up menu appears.

Pro tip

To avoid typos or spelling errors in your text, you can use Apple Intelligence writing tools to proofread your text by copy-pasting it in Notes.

Benefits of scheduling Instagram messages

Scheduling your Instagram messages offers various benefits, whether you are a person who uses Instagram just to interact with friends or a social media creator who uses Instagram for personal branding. Here are the top benefits of scheduling your Instagram messages:

  • Scheduled messages can help you maintain consistent communication with your audience.
  • Send birthday or event reminders in advance.
  • Boost productivity by managing outreach tasks in batches.
  • Increase engagement by sending messages during high-activity times.

Signing off…

That’s pretty much it; this was all from us on scheduling Instagram messages in advance to save time and build meaningful connections with your audience. Remember to double-check your message for typos and spelling errors so you don’t have to face embarrassment or delete it later.

Will you use Instagram’s schedule messages feature, or are you better off without it? Do share your thoughts in the comments.

You might also like:

  • How to see who unfollowed you on Instagram
  • How to see your liked posts on Instagram
  • How to turn off activity status on Instagram

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

@graph.name: How to Schedule Instagram Messages on iPhone
@graph.description: Learn how to schedule direct messages on Instagram using your iPhone so you never miss a perfect moment to send a DM.

step.name: Open Instagram and go to Direct Messages
step.text: Launch the Instagram app and swipe left from the home screen to access your Direct Messages.

itemListElement.text: Open the Instagram app on your iPhone.
Swipe left on the home feed to open the DM section.

step.name: Compose or open a conversation
step.text: Start a new chat or open an existing one where you want to schedule a message.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Compose button in the top-right corner to begin a new message.
Alternatively, tap on any existing conversation.

step.name: Type your message
step.text: Enter the message you want to schedule in the text field.

itemListElement.text: Type out the message you want to send later.

step.name: Schedule the message
step.text: Press and hold the Send button, pick a date and time, and confirm the scheduled send.

itemListElement.text: Long-press the Send button to bring up the scheduling menu.
Select your desired date and time.
Tap the Send at [time] button to confirm.

step.name: View scheduled message
step.text: A scheduled message bar will appear, confirming your DM is queued to send.

itemListElement.text: Look for the scheduled message indicator above the chat field.

@graph.name: How to See Your Scheduled Messages on Instagram
@graph.description: Find and review your scheduled messages in Instagram DMs on your iPhone with this quick and easy guide.

step.name: Open the Direct Message conversation
step.text: Launch Instagram and open the DM chat where you've scheduled a message.

itemListElement.text: Open the Instagram app on your iPhone.
Navigate to the Direct Message tab and tap the conversation with the scheduled message.

step.name: Tap on scheduled messages
step.text: Tap the 'scheduled' label above the text field to see your pending messages.

itemListElement.text: Look just above the message box for the scheduled messages option and tap it.

step.name: Review scheduled messages
step.text: Your scheduled messages will appear along with their respective dates and times.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through the list to see all your upcoming scheduled messages.

@graph.name: How to Immediately Send a Scheduled Message on Instagram
@graph.description: Need to send a scheduled Instagram DM right away? Here's how you can instantly send a pre-scheduled message on your iPhone.

step.name: Open the scheduled messages screen
step.text: Launch Instagram and navigate to the Direct Message conversation containing the scheduled message.

itemListElement.text: Open Instagram and tap the DM conversation where the message is scheduled.
Tap the 'scheduled' label above the message box to view scheduled messages.

step.name: Send the message immediately
step.text: Tap and hold the scheduled message, then tap 'Send Now' from the pop-up menu.

itemListElement.text: Long press the message you want to send.
Tap 'Send Now' when the pop-up appears.

@graph.name: How to Cancel a Scheduled Message on Instagram
@graph.description: Changed your mind about a scheduled DM? Here’s how to quickly delete a scheduled Instagram message on your iPhone.

step.name: Access your scheduled messages
step.text: Open the Instagram app and go to the Direct Message conversation where the scheduled message exists.

itemListElement.text: Open Instagram and navigate to the DM conversation with the scheduled message.
Tap the 'scheduled' label to view your pending messages.

step.name: Delete the scheduled message
step.text: Tap and hold the scheduled message, then select 'Delete' from the pop-up menu to cancel it.

itemListElement.text: Tap and hold the scheduled message you wish to cancel.
Tap 'Delete' in the pop-up that appears.

keyPoints.title: Scheduling DMs on Instagram via iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: You can easily schedule a direct message on Instagram by updating the app, typing your message, then long-pressing the send button to pick a date and time for sending.

keyPoints.title: Managing scheduled Instagram messages
keyPoints.explanation: You can view, send immediately, or delete your scheduled messages through the Direct Message conversation, making it easy to control your outreach.

keyPoints.title: How to view and send scheduled messages instantly
keyPoints.explanation: Scheduled messages are accessible within the conversation, where you can choose to send them right away by holding the message and selecting 'Send Now'.

keyPoints.title: Canceling a scheduled message
keyPoints.explanation: While you cannot edit a scheduled message on Instagram, you can delete it by long-pressing the message and choosing 'Delete' to prevent it from sending.

keyPoints.title: Benefits of scheduling Instagram messages
keyPoints.explanation: Scheduling helps maintain consistent communication, prepare reminders ahead of time, boost productivity, and engage audiences during peak activity periods.

title.rendered: How to see and delete your iPhone call history

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The 100 Call Limit: Your iPhone’s “Recents” tab stores details for your last 100 calls, including cellular and FaceTime, but older entries are automatically removed from view.
  • How to View History: You can view your most recent calls in the Phone app’s “Recents” tab. For a more detailed or older history, check your mobile carrier’s website.
  • How to Delete: To delete a single call from your log, simply swipe left on the entry. To delete all of them at once, tap “Edit” then “Clear.”
  • Effect of Deletion: Deleting a call removes it from your iPhone permanently, but the record of that call will still exist on your carrier’s official billing statements.
  • Backups and Recovery: Your call history is included in your iCloud backups, which means you can potentially recover a deleted log by restoring your iPhone from an older backup.

Want to know whose call you missed or how long you talked to someone? The Phone app on your iPhone lets you view all incoming, outgoing, and missed calls, along with voicemails. Plus, you can also delete your call history to keep your call logs clean or prevent others from seeing it, among other reasons.

Keep reading, and I’ll show you how to see and delete your call history on an iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Essential things to know about iPhone call history
  • How to see your call history on iPhone
    • View recent calls using the Phone app
    • Check through your carrier
  • How to delete call history on iPhone
    • Delete a single call
    • Clear entire call history
  • What happens after deleting your call history?

Essential things to know about iPhone call history

The call history on your iPhone is not just a list of calls, it’s a record of details about your communication activity. Here’s what you need to know:

  • What’s included in call history: Each call entry in the iPhone Phone app contains the contact’s name (if saved in Contacts) or phone number, the time the call was made or received, its duration, and whether it was incoming, outgoing, or missed.
  • How long is it stored: iPhones typically store up to 100 of your most recent calls. Once this limit is reached, older entries are automatically removed to make room for new ones.
  • Call syncing with iCloud: If you use iCloud and have call syncing enabled, your call history is backed up and accessible across all your Apple devices logged into the same iCloud account. This is convenient for quick access but might raise privacy concerns if you share devices with others.
  • Deleted calls and backups: Even after deleting call history from your iPhone, it might still exist in older iCloud or Mac backups. Restoring your device from these backups can recover deleted entries.

How to see your call history on iPhone

Accessing your call history on an iPhone is straightforward. Here are two ways to do this.

View recent calls using the Phone app

The Phone app is the easiest way to access call history on an iPhone. As already mentioned, this encompasses cellular calls, FaceTime calls, and those from apps like Zoom and WhatsApp. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open the Phone app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Recents at the bottom of the screen. Here, you’ll see a list of all your recent calls, with the most recent at the top, along with the call date or time to their right.
  3. Calls are color-coded and marked with icons to help you identify their type. Here’s a quick breakdown to assess a call:
    • Red: Missed calls.
    • Black or White: Incoming and outgoing calls in Dark and Light themes, respectively. The outgoing voice calls and video calls will have a phone and camcorder icon with an outward arrow, respectively. Remember, the incoming calls have no icons.
    • If it’s an unknown number, you’ll see the caller’s probable location. This helps to identify international calls. Also, if it’s any automated number, the company or customer support name is displayed.
    • For the numbers saved on your iPhone, it shows call type such as, iPhone, Mobile, FaceTime Video, WhatsApp Audio, etc., under the contact’s name.
  4. Tap on the i icon next to an entry to view more details, such as duration, date and time, call type, and data spent in FaceTime calls. You can also directly call back the number or send a message from this screen.

  5. If you want to see the missed calls only, tap the Missed tab at the top.

Can’t see call history from a specific contact? Use the search bar at the top to find calls by typing contact name or phone number. You can also search by date, or the app used for the call. Once you see a search result, tap See All to get the whole call history along with the old ones.

Check through your carrier

If you need a more extensive history that isn’t displayed in the Phone app, you can often access detailed call logs through your carrier’s account portal or app. Log in to your account and navigate to the Call History or Usage Details section. This may vary depending on your carrier’s interface.

Here, you can view detailed call logs, including calls that might have been removed from your iPhone’s history. Some carriers often retain call logs for several months, depending on their policy. Now, you may download your call history as a PDF or CSV file for your records.

If you’re unable to find the information you need, contact your carrier’s customer service for assistance. They can provide additional details or guide you through accessing your call records.

How to delete call history on iPhone

Deleting your call history is as easy as viewing it. Whether you’d like to delete one entry or wipe the entire call logs, here’s how to do it:

Delete a single call

  1. Open the Phone app and go to the Recents tab.
  2. Swipe left on the call entry you want to delete and tap the trash icon.

Note Unfortunately, it’s not possible to delete multiple call logs together on your iPhone. You can only delete call history individually or all at once.

Clear entire call history

  1. In the Phone app, navigate to the Recents tab.
  2. Tap Edit in the top-left corner and hit Select in the context menu.

  3. Finally, tap Clear in the top-right corner and tap Clear All Recents in the confirmation prompt to confirm your choice.

This will delete all call logs at once. If you have enabled iCloud syncing, your call history is updated across all your compatible devices.

Tip Before clearing your entire call history, double-check for any numbers or details you might want to save. Once deleted, this information cannot be recovered unless it exists in a backup.

What happens after deleting your call history?

When you delete your call history, the following changes occur:

  • What’s removed: All details about the deleted calls, including contact names, numbers, times, and durations, are permanently erased from your iPhone. They will no longer appear in the Recents tab.
  • What stays: Deleting call history does not affect other features. For example, the contact information in the Contacts app remains untouched, and call logs stored by your carrier are unaffected.
  • Backups may still retain the data: Deleted call history entries may still exist in your iCloud or iTunes backups if they were created before you cleared the calls. You can recover them by restoring your device from an iCloud backup.
  • Privacy and security: Deleting your call history can help protect your privacy, especially if you’re concerned about someone accessing your phone. It’s a good practice if you share your device with others or are preparing to sell or trade it in. You may also hide specific contacts on your iPhone to ensure others can’t get hands on them.

Signing off…

I hope the above guide helps you view and delete recent call history on your iPhone. Make it a practice to regularly review your call history going forward, as this will ensure your privacy and keep the Phone app clutter-free.

While Apple lets you delete call history for apps like WhatsApp in the Phone app, they still appear in their respective apps. If you wish to clear them from their respective apps, too, you’ll need to go into the apps and delete the logs.

FAQs

Does iCloud backup include call history?

Yes, if iCloud backup is enabled, your call history is included in the backup. However, this data won’t be accessible separately unless you restore your iPhone from the backup.

Is there a way to automatically delete call history after a certain period?

No, iPhones don’t currently have a built-in feature to automatically delete call history after a set time. You’ll need to manually clear your call logs when needed.

Can I retrieve deleted call history on iPhone?

Yes, it’s possible to recover deleted call history if you’ve backed up your device to iCloud or iTunes before deleting it. Check out this guide for detailed instructions: How to recover deleted call history on iPhone.

  • How to delete duplicate contacts on an iPhone
  • How to stop the power button from ending calls on iPhone in 4 steps

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

@graph.name: How to Delete Single Call History on iPhone
@graph.description: Quickly remove an individual call entry from the Recents tab in your iPhone’s Phone app to keep your call log tidy.

step.name: Open the Phone app
step.text: Unlock your iPhone, tap the Phone app icon, and navigate to the Recents tab.

itemListElement.text: Locate the Phone app on your Home Screen or App Library.
Tap the Phone icon to open it.
Tap Recents at the bottom to view your call log.

step.name: Delete a call entry
step.text: Swipe left on the specific call you want to remove, then tap the trash icon to delete it.

itemListElement.text: Find the call entry you want to delete.
Swipe left on the entry.
Tap the red trash icon to confirm deletion.

@graph.name: How to Delete Entire Call History on iPhone
@graph.description: Easily clear all call entries from the Recents tab in the Phone app on your iPhone to remove your entire call log in one go.

step.name: Open the Phone app and Recents tab
step.text: Unlock your iPhone, open the Phone app, and navigate to the Recents tab to view your call log.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Phone app icon from your Home Screen or App Library.
Select the Recents tab at the bottom to see your recent calls.

step.name: Select calls to delete
step.text: Tap Edit in the top-left corner and select the Select option to prepare for clearing your call history.

itemListElement.text: Tap Edit in the upper-left corner of the Recents tab.
Choose Select from the menu that appears.

step.name: Clear all recents
step.text: Tap Clear in the top-right corner, then confirm by selecting Clear All Recents in the pop-up.

itemListElement.text: Tap Clear in the top-right corner of the screen.
In the confirmation prompt, tap Clear All Recents to delete your entire call history.

keyPoints.title: Call history details on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: Your iPhone's call history records cellular, FaceTime, and third-party app calls, including call type, duration, and time, with a limit of storing the 100 most recent calls.

keyPoints.title: Viewing call history
keyPoints.explanation: You can easily access your recent call logs through the Phone app's Recents tab or through your carrier's website or app for more detailed logs.

keyPoints.title: Deleting call history
keyPoints.explanation: Delete individual calls by swiping left on the call entry or clear all logs via the Edit and Clear options in the Phone app, keeping your call logs tidy and private.

keyPoints.title: What happens after deletion
keyPoints.explanation: Deleted calls are permanently removed from your iPhone but may still exist in backups, and deleting enhances your privacy while not affecting contact info or carrier records.

keyPoints.title: Additional tips and privacy considerations
keyPoints.explanation: Call history may be included in iCloud backups, and there is no automatic deletion feature; recovered deleted logs are possible via backups, which can be useful for privacy or record-keeping.

title.rendered: Wi-Fi Calling Not Working on Your iPhone? Here’s How to Fix It!

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Common Problem: After a major iOS update, some users face Wi-Fi calling issues. First, always ensure your device is connected to a stable Wi-Fi network.
  • Enable the Setting: Next, confirm that Wi-Fi Calling is enabled for your line by going to Settings > Cellular > Wi-Fi Calling and toggling the switch on.
  • Check Carrier Support: Verify that your mobile carrier (like Jio, Airtel, or Vi) actually supports Wi-Fi calling and that your emergency address information is up to date.
  • Reset Network Settings: For persistent issues, resetting your network settings can often resolve the problem, but be aware this erases all your saved Wi-Fi passwords.
  • Final Steps: If problems continue, try restarting your iPhone, checking for a carrier settings update, or contacting your mobile carrier’s support team for direct assistance.

Wi-Fi calling is a lifesaver when you’re in areas with poor cellular reception. It allows you to make calls and send texts over a Wi-Fi network. However, if your iPhone’s Wi-Fi calling stopped working after the iOS 18 update, you’re not alone. Many users have reported the issue on Reddit. In this guide, I’ll share possible reasons for the Wi-Fi calling not working issue and step-by-step solutions to fix it.

Table of Contents
  • Why is Wi-Fi calling not working on iPhone?
  • 6 Best ways to fix Wi-Fi calling not working on iPhone
    • 1. Check if your iPhone is connected to Wi-Fi
    • 2. Make sure Wi-Fi Calling is turned on
    • 3. Reset Network Settings
    • 4. Restart your iPhone
    • 5. Erase All Content and Settings on iPhone
    • 6. Contact your wireless carrier

Why is Wi-Fi calling not working on iPhone?

There are several reasons why Wi-Fi calling might not work on your iPhone after the iOS 18 update. Let’s find out:

  • Wi-Fi calling is turned off: If Wi-Fi calling isn’t working, the option may be toggled off on your iPhone.
  • Unstable or poor Wi-Fi connection: Wi-Fi calling requires a stable and strong Wi-Fi connection to function properly. So, if your Wi-Fi network is slow, experiencing interruptions, or has a weak signal, you may not be able to place calls or send texts.
  • iOS bugs: Every iOS update, including iOS 18, can come with bugs or compatibility glitches that may interfere with certain features like Wi-Fi calling. If this is the case, it’s a temporary issue.
  • Outdated carrier or Wi-Fi calling support: Not all carriers support Wi-Fi calling, or they may require you to enable it manually in their settings. Additionally, your carrier may have specific requirements for using Wi-Fi calling, such as enabling VoLTE (Voice over LTE).
  • Incorrect date and time settings: For network synchronization, Wi-Fi calling relies on the correct date and time settings. Your iPhone’s date and time, if not set correctly, can cause problems while connecting to the service.
  • Network issues with your carrier: Sometimes the issue is not with your iPhone but with your carrier. There could be a brief outage or service interruption that is causing Wi-Fi calling to malfunction.

Now that you know the potential culprit, you can troubleshoot it better and get your Wi-Fi calling feature up and running again. Now, on to the solutions!

6 Best ways to fix Wi-Fi calling not working on iPhone

The only way to know for sure is by systematically troubleshooting the cause of the error, which is exactly what I have detailed in this section.

1. Check if your iPhone is connected to Wi-Fi

It is pretty apparent that you can’t use Wi-Fi calling if your phone isn’t connected to a Wi-Fi network.

Go to Settings → Wi-Fi and check whether you’re connected to a Wi-Fi network. If not, connect to one.

You can also check if the connection is actually working by opening your browser and visiting any website you like.

If it’s working well, try the next solution below.

2. Make sure Wi-Fi Calling is turned on


Most iPhones (iPhone 5c or later) support Wi-Fi calling, but carrier support is essential. Once confirmed, here’s how to enable it:

  1. Go to Settings and tap Cellular.

  2. Now, tap Wi-Fi Calling and make sure it’s toggled on.

3. Reset Network Settings

Resetting your Network Settings may fix Wi-Fi calling not working on your iPhone. Here’s what to do:

  1. Go to Settings → General → Transfer or Reset iPhone.

  2. Now, tap Reset → Reset Network Settings. Enter your passcode and tap to confirm and erase your Wi-Fi settings.

Is Wi-Fi calling still not working? Give the next solution a shot.

4. Restart your iPhone

Sometimes, simply rebooting your iPhone can fix the problem. To do so:

Press and hold the Side and Volume buttons simultaneously on an iPhone X or newer model until the power slider appears. Swipe it to the right to turn off your iPhone. Wait a few moments and press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen.

If you have updated your iPhone to iOS 18, you can also turn off your iPhone using the Control Center. Scroll down to the control center and tap the power icon in the top right corner.

5. Erase All Content and Settings on iPhone

This is a pretty extreme step, as it will restore your iPhone to its factory default settings. Ensure you have a backup of all your data before proceeding with this step.

See our in-depth guide on how to factory reset your iPhone for more information.

6. Contact your wireless carrier

If none of the above steps work to fix Wi-Fi calling on your iPhone, you should contact your wireless carrier and explain the situation to their support staff.

It’s possible that your account has an issue, and a customer service representative could help you resolve it.

Wrapping Up…

I hope these solutions come in handy to fix all your Wi-Fi calling issues on your iPhone.

I’d love to know which one worked for you. Please leave your thoughts in the comments below. We also look forward to hearing if you have any other Apple-related questions.

  • 10 Ways to boost Wi-Fi signal on iPhone and iPad

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

acceptedAnswer.text: No, iPhones don't currently have a built-in feature to automatically delete call history after a set time. You'll need to manually clear your call logs when needed.

mainEntity.name: Can I retrieve deleted call history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it's possible to recover deleted call history if you've backed up your device to iCloud or iTunes before deleting it. Check out this guide for detailed instructions: How to recover deleted call history on iPhone.

title.rendered: How to Forward iCloud Email to Another Email Account

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • How to Forward Mail: To set up automatic iCloud mail forwarding, go to iCloud.com > iCloud Mail > Settings > Mail Forwarding > select Forward my emails to > enter email address.
  • Use Rules for Filtering: To add rule filter to iCloud mail forwarding, go to iCloud.com > iCloud Mail > Settings > Rules > Add a Rule > Set up filter.
  • Managing Your Setup: You can manage your setup at any time by returning to the iCloud.com Mail settings to edit your rules or completely disable the forwarding feature.
  • The Main Benefit: This feature is ideal for centralizing all your communications into a single primary inbox, ensuring you never miss an important email sent to your iCloud address.
  • Important Tip: When setting up forwarding, consider checking the “Keep a copy” option to ensure that forwarded messages are also saved within your iCloud Mail inbox.

Planning to ditch your iCloud email address as your primary one, but can’t because it’s used for all your important communications, such as bank statements, shopping bills, travel plans, or personal business? While you can update your email for every important service, the process can be tedious, as the list might be long.

This is why forwarding your iCloud emails to another email account is an excellent solution for centralizing your communications. With that said, read on to learn how.

Table of Contents
  • How to automatically forward all iCloud emails to another email
  • Forward specific iCloud emails
    • Change or delete email filtering rules
  • How to stop iCloud email forwarding

How to automatically forward all iCloud emails to another email

Setting up automatic forwarding on your iCloud emails is pretty straightforward, but sadly, you can’t do so on the Mail app on iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Let me show you how it’s done:

  1. Go to iCloud.com and sign in using your Apple Account.
  2. Now, scroll down and click on the Mail app icon to access iCloud Mail.

  3. Here, click the Settings icon at the top of the Mailbox list.

  4. Then select Settings in the drop-down menu.

  5. Next, select Mail Forwarding in the settings menu and click the “Forward my email to” checkbox, then enter the email address to which you want to forward all your iCloud emails.

Note You can click the “delete messages after forwarding” checkbox if you want to save some iCloud storage, but remember, once a message is deleted, it is gone forever.

Forward specific iCloud emails

Not all emails are as important as others; the most important ones can get lost in the massive pile of forwarded emails. To fix this issue, you can set up rules to filter all incoming emails forwarded to another email. Here’s how:

  1. On iCloud.com, click on the Mail app icon to access iCloud Mail.
  2. Here, click the Settings icon, then select the Settings option in the drop-down menu.
  3. Next, select Rules in the settings menu.
  4. Now, click on + Add a Rule.

  5. Here do the following:
    • Give your new rule a name.
    • Use the pop-up menu and text field under Message to specify what kind of emails you want to filter.
    • Use the pop-up menu and text field under Action to specify what action you want your rule to take.
  6. Click Add.

Change or delete email filtering rules

While Apple allows you to create up to 500 rules, you don’t need to create a new one every time a new condition enters your mind. You can update a previously created rule instead. Also, you can easily delete a previously added rule if it is no longer required.

Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Go to iCloud.com → Mail → Settings → Rules.
  2. Here, select the Rule you want to delete.

  3. Next, update the rule filters and name and click Save.
  4. Otherwise, click Delete Rule.

  5. Finally, click Delete to confirm.

Note Apple says a new or updated rule can take up to 15 minutes to come into action.

How to stop iCloud email forwarding

You can easily stop forwarding email if you no longer need it. Follow these steps to do so:

  1. Click on the Mail app icon on iCloud.com.
  2. Click the Settings icon, then select the Settings option in the drop-down menu.
  3. Click on Mail Forwarding, then deselect “Forward my email to.”

Signing off…

This is how you can set automatic mail forwarding on your iCloud emails, which can help you save time and streamline your email management. Moreover, the ability to add filters or stop email forwarding at any time gives you more control and flexibility over how you want to handle your emails.

We hope this guide answers all your queries. However, if you still have some, feel free to reach out to us via comments.

Also read:

  • How to create a new iCloud email account
  • How to color-code emails on Mac to visually categorize them
  • How to set up auto-reply in Apple Mail on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

@graph.description: Set up automatic email forwarding in iCloud Mail so all incoming messages are sent to another email address without manual intervention.

step.name: Sign in to iCloud.com
step.text: Go to iCloud.com and sign in with your Apple Account.

itemListElement.text: Open your preferred browser and visit iCloud.com.
Enter your Apple ID and password, then complete two-factor authentication if prompted.

step.name: Open iCloud Mail settings
step.text: Click the Mail app icon, then click the Settings icon at the top of the Mailbox list and choose Settings from the drop-down.

itemListElement.text: Select the Mail app from the iCloud home screen.
Click the gear icon at the top of the mailbox list.
Choose Settings from the menu.

step.name: Enable mail forwarding
step.text: In the Mail Forwarding section, check 'Forward my email to' and enter the email address where you want messages sent.

itemListElement.text: Locate the Mail Forwarding settings.
Select the checkbox for 'Forward my email to'.
Type in your forwarding email address and confirm.

@graph.name: How to Forward Specific iCloud Emails
@graph.description: Learn how to forward only certain emails from iCloud Mail by creating custom rules in iCloud.com settings.

step.name: Open iCloud Mail
step.text: Sign in to iCloud.com with your Apple ID, then click the Mail app icon to open iCloud Mail.

itemListElement.text: Go to iCloud.com in your preferred web browser.
Sign in using your Apple ID credentials and two-factor authentication if required.
Click the Mail app icon to enter iCloud Mail.

step.name: Access Mail settings
step.text: Click the Settings icon at the top of the mailbox list, then select Settings from the drop-down menu.

itemListElement.text: Click the gear icon in the top menu of iCloud Mail.
Choose Settings from the drop-down list.

step.name: Create a forwarding rule
step.text: Go to the Rules tab, click '+ Add a Rule', and define the filter and forwarding action.

itemListElement.text: In the Rules section, click '+ Add a Rule'.
Name your rule for easy reference.
Under 'If a message', set the condition for the type of emails you want to forward (e.g., sender, subject, keywords).
Under 'Then', choose 'Forward to' and enter the forwarding email address.
Click Add to save the rule.

step.text: Select the rule, then either make changes to the filters and name and click Save, or click Delete Rule to remove it.

keyPoints.title: Setting Up Automatic iCloud Mail Forwarding
keyPoints.explanation: You can automatically forward your iCloud emails to another account by accessing iCloud Mail settings on iCloud.com and enabling the forwarding option.

keyPoints.title: Adding Rules to Filter Forwarded Emails
keyPoints.explanation: To prioritize important emails, create rules in iCloud Mail settings to filter specific emails and direct them to your preferred folder or address.

keyPoints.title: Managing and Updating Email Rules
keyPoints.explanation: Customize or delete existing email filtering rules within iCloud Mail to ensure your forwarding preferences stay relevant and organized.

keyPoints.title: Stopping iCloud Email Forwarding
keyPoints.explanation: To stop forwarding emails, simply disable the forwarding option in your iCloud Mail settings whenever you no longer need the feature.

keyPoints.title: Benefits of Email Forwarding and Filtering
keyPoints.explanation: Forwarding and filtering iCloud emails help centralize communications and improve email management, especially when switching to a new primary email.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Rolls Out New Tools to Spot Scam Messages

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • WhatsApp scams often start with fake messages offering jobs, money, or urgent help. Many of these scams trace back to organized cybercrime groups running crypto and pyramid schemes.
  • Meta banned over 6.8 million WhatsApp accounts in early 2025 as part of a crackdown on scams, including operations with OpenAI to stop AI-powered fraud networks.
  • New safety overview pops up for unknown group invites, letting you check who added you, read safety tips, or leave instantly without opening the group chat.
  • Test alerts warn when you’re messaging strangers, helping users spot suspicious contact attempts, especially after scams migrated from other platforms.
  • Meta urges users to verify requests by pausing, checking context, and using trusted apps to confirm identities before replying or sending anything.

Do you get suspicious messages on WhatsApp offering easy money, fake jobs, or urgent requests from unknown numbers? You’re not alone. Scammers are everywhere, and WhatsApp is now stepping in with new tools to help you identify and avoid them before it’s too late.

Scamming has become a full-blown business. Many of these messages come from criminal scam centers, often located in Southeast Asia and sometimes linked to forced labor. These operations run various schemes, from fake crypto investments to pyramid scams. The trick is always the same: they ask for upfront payments with promises of big returns that never arrive.

According to Meta, its security teams are constantly working to detect and block such scams. In just the first half of 2025, WhatsApp banned over 6.8 million accounts linked to scam networks, often before they even reached potential victims. In one recent case, Meta, WhatsApp, and OpenAI collaborated to shut down a Cambodia-based scam ring that used ChatGPT to craft convincing scam messages.

Two New WhatsApp Anti-Scam Features

To make it even harder for scams to sneak through, WhatsApp is rolling out two new safety tools.

1. Group Safety Overview

If someone not in your contacts adds you to a WhatsApp group, you’ll now see a safety overview. This will show details about the group along with safety tips. You can leave the group without opening the chat or view more context if it seems familiar. Notifications from such groups will also stay muted until you decide whether to remain.

2. Alerts for Unknown Contacts

Scammers often start their con on other platforms like SMS or dating apps before continuing on WhatsApp. To tackle this, WhatsApp is testing alerts that pop up when you message someone who’s not saved in your contacts. These alerts will help you decide whether it’s safe to proceed.

Meta’s Golden Rule: Pause, Question, Verify

Along with the new features, Meta is encouraging users to think twice before responding. Here’s their simple 3-step guide:

  • Pause: Stop and consider if you recognize the number or if the request sounds legitimate.
  • Question: Does it make sense? Are they offering unrealistic pay, rushing you, or asking for money, gift cards, or PIN codes?
  • Verify: If it’s supposedly a friend or family member, confirm their identity through another channel — call them directly or use a number you know is real.

These updates are rolling out globally on both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store. So, if you see new safety prompts popping up in your chats, that’s WhatsApp quietly working behind the scenes to help you stay one step ahead of scammers.

For extra protection, you can also enable WhatsApp’s Advanced Chat Privacy features, which give you more control over who can reach you and how your chats are secured.

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

acceptedAnswer.text: Allowance of third-party payment systems, the possibility for app sideloading in the EU, reduced commissions, and stricter data transparency are among the few significant App Store policy changes that took place in 2025.

mainEntity.name: Is sideloading allowed on iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only in the European Union as of late 2025. Other regions remain closed to sideloading for now. How much commission does Apple now charge? keyPoints.title: WhatsApp's Growing Scam Threats
keyPoints.explanation: Scammers using fake messages offering money, jobs, or urgent requests are prevalent on WhatsApp, often originating from criminal centers linked to various scams like crypto investments and pyramid schemes.

keyPoints.title: Meta's Efforts to Combat Scams
keyPoints.explanation: Meta actively detects and blocks scam accounts on WhatsApp, banning over 6.8 million in the first half of 2025, including collaborative operations with OpenAI to shut down scam rings leveraging AI.

keyPoints.title: New Group Safety Overview Feature
keyPoints.explanation: When added to a WhatsApp group by an unknown contact, users will now see a safety overview, receive tips, and can choose to leave or view more info without opening the chat.

keyPoints.title: Alerts for Unknown Contacts
keyPoints.explanation: WhatsApp is testing alerts that notify users when they message someone not saved in their contacts, helping them decide if the interaction is safe, especially after scams on other platforms.

keyPoints.title: Meta's Golden Rules for Safety
keyPoints.explanation: Meta recommends pausing to assess, questioning suspicious requests, and verifying identities through trusted channels to avoid falling victim to scams on WhatsApp.

socialPosts.linkedin: Have you ever received a suspicious message on WhatsApp promising easy money, fake jobs, or urgent help? You're not alone. Scammers are becoming more sophisticated, often operating through organized cybercrime groups involved in crypto and pyramid schemes. But here's some good news: WhatsApp is stepping up its security game with new features designed to keep us safer. Key takeaways: - WhatsApp has banned over 6.8 million scam accounts in early 2025, working in collaboration with organizations like OpenAI to combat AI-powered fraud. - New safety tools include a Group Safety Overview for unknown group invites and alerts for messages from unknown contacts, helping users spot suspicious activity early. - Meta recommends a simple 3-step approach: Pause, Question, Verify, to prevent falling for scams. As someone who values digital safety, I find these updates encouraging—they remind us to stay vigilant and verify before reacting to unexpected requests. The fight against scams is ongoing, but with these tools, we’re better equipped to protect ourselves. Are you already using any of these features? How do you stay cautious about scam messages in your digital interactions? Share your tips or experiences! Learn more about these features and how WhatsApp is making messaging safer here: WhatsApp New Anti-Scam Features. #CyberSecurity #WhatsAppSafety #DigitalSafety #TechUpdates #StaySafe

title.rendered: How to use Inspect Element on a Mac to modify webpages

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Overview: Inspect Element is a built-in browser tool for developers and designers to view, debug, and temporarily modify the HTML and CSS code of any webpage.
  • Uses of Inspect Element: Use it to test design changes in real-time, debug layout issues, identify performance bottlenecks, or extract specific text and image assets from a webpage.
  • How to Access It: To open it, right-click and select “Inspect.” For Safari, you must first enable the “Develop” menu in the Advanced settings before you can access it.
  • Temporarily Modify Webpages: Any changes you make to a webpage’s code using Inspect Element are temporary and only visible on your computer; they disappear when you refresh the page.
  • Important Tips: Always use this tool ethically for learning and testing. Modifying websites for malicious purposes or to create misleading screenshots can have serious consequences.

Inspect Element, also called Inspect, is a versatile tool built into browsers. Contrary to popular misconception, it’s as valuable for designers and developers as casual users. As a casual user, you can use Inspect Element on macOS devices to learn more about a webpage, extract some information or data from a webpage, or modify web page content, among other things.

Keep reading, and I will show you how to use Inspect Element on your Mac.

Table of Contents
  • What is Inspect Element?
  • How to access Inspect Element on different browsers
    • On Safari
    • On Chrome
    • On Firefox
  • How to use Inspect Element to modify a webpage
    • Edit text on a webpage
    • Change images on a webpage
    • Modify colors and styles
    • Replace hyperlinks

What is Inspect Element?

If you always wondered what makes a website work, including the one you’re on right now, here’s an analogy that could help. Think of a website as a building: the structure and framework are crafted with HTML and JavaScript, while CSS adds the paint and decor.

Inspect Element lets you peel back the layers to see the blueprint of any webpage. But there’s more to it, and you may use Inspect Element to do a whole bunch of other things, like:

  • Debug errors in code: You can quickly check and resolve issues in HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
  • Test design changes: You can even experiment with layouts, colors, and fonts.
  • Analyze website performance: You can check for website’s responsiveness and understand loading behaviors.
  • Copy elements: You can easily grab text, images, or styles from websites as long as you’re not violating anything.
  • Modify content temporarily: You can edit text, images, or other elements that will reflect in real-time.
  • Understanding SEO: You can analyze meta tags, headers (H1, H2, H3…), and keyword placement.

How to access Inspect Element on different browsers

Now that you have a basic idea of what Inspect Element can do, let’s see how to use it on your Mac across different browsers. You can use Inspect Element across popular browsers such as Safari, Chrome and Firefox. I’ll show you how.

On Safari

  1. Open Safari.
  2. Click Safari in the top menu bar and select Settings.

  3. Go to the Advanced tab and make sure to enable the Show Features for Web Developers option.

  4. Go to the webpage you want to analyze or modify, Control-click on any element, and select Inspect Element.

On Chrome

  1. Open Chrome and go to the webpage you want to inspect.
  2. Control-click anywhere on the page and select Inspect. Alternatively, you can use the Command+Option+I keyboard shortcut to bring up the DevTools panel.

Note These steps also work on Chromium-based browsers like Microsoft Edge, Opera, and Arc Browser.

On Firefox

  1. Open Firefox and go to the website you’d like to inspect.
  2. Control-click on any element and choose Inspect. Or use Command+Option+I to bring up the Developer Tools.

How to use Inspect Element to modify a webpage

As already mentioned, you can use Inspect Element to edit website content temporarily, which can be useful for design experimentation, testing changes, or just pulling pranks. Here’s how to do this.

Edit text on a webpage

  1. Open the webpage and select the text you want to modify.
  2. Control-click the text and select Inspect.

  3. You will now see the HTML code for the selected element highlighted in the Developer Tools panel. Click it, type your new text, and hit Return.

Your changes will appear instantly on the webpage. However, take note that they are temporary.

Change images on a webpage

  1. Control-click the image you want to modify and select Inspect.
  2. In the Developer Tools panel, look for the tag with the src attribute. (Here, src implies source of the image.)

  3. Replace the URL in the src attribute with the URL of the new image you want to display.
  4. Press Return, and the image will update instantly.

Modify colors and styles

  1. Control-click on the element whose style you want to change and select Inspect.
  2. Navigate to the Styles section in the Developer Tools panel.

  3. Edit CSS properties like color, font-size, or background-color directly in the panel. You can check out HTML Color Codes to quickly get HTML color codes.

Replace hyperlinks

  1. Control-click on a hyperlink and select Inspect.
  2. Locate the tag in the HTML with the href attribute.
  3. Change the href value to a different URL and press Return.
  4. Click the modified link to test the new destination.
Pro Tip Take screenshots of your edits before refreshing the page, as all changes are temporary and will revert when the page reloads.

Signing off…

As you just saw, it’s easy to use Inspect Element on a Mac to perform various manipulations and operations on a webpage. Sure, you may feel intimidated looking at website code at first, but as you use the tool more and more, you will find yourself at ease and be able to do much more than what we have covered in the guide.

FAQs

Will Inspect Element change the way a website looks for other users?

No, the changes are only visible on your end and disappear when the page is refreshed. They don’t affect the actual website or other users.

Is it illegal to use Inspect Element on websites that aren’t mine?

You can use Inspect Element to learn how websites function or experiment with design. However, copying a website’s code, bypassing restrictions, or phishing could be illegal and may land you in trouble, depending on where you live.

What happens if I accidentally delete an element while using Inspect Element?

Deleting an element in Inspect Element only hides it temporarily. You can refresh the page to restore everything to original state.
