mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can use Inspect Element to learn how websites function or experiment with design. However, copying a website's code, bypassing restrictions, or phishing could be illegal and may land you in trouble, depending on where you live.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I accidentally delete an element while using Inspect Element?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deleting an element in Inspect Element only hides it temporarily. You can refresh the page to restore everything to original state.

step.name: Open Safari settings
step.text: Open Safari, click Safari in the top menu bar, and select Settings.

itemListElement.text: Click Safari in the top menu bar.
Select Settings from the dropdown menu.

step.name: Enable developer features
step.text: Go to the Advanced tab and enable the Show Features for Web Developers option.

itemListElement.text: Navigate to the Advanced tab.

step.name: Inspect a webpage element
step.text: Go to the webpage you want to analyze, Control-click on any element, and select Inspect Element.

itemListElement.text: Right-click or Control-click on any page element.
Select Inspect from the context menu.
Alternatively, press Command+Option+I (Mac) or Ctrl+Shift+I (Windows).

keyPoints.title: Inspect Element Overview
keyPoints.explanation: Inspect Element is a built-in browser tool that allows users to view and modify webpage code, useful for debugging, design testing, and extracting information.

keyPoints.title: Main Uses of Inspect Element
keyPoints.explanation: You can debug errors, test design changes, analyze performance, copy elements, temporarily modify content, and understand SEO aspects of websites.

keyPoints.title: Accessing Inspect Element on Safari, Chrome, and Firefox
keyPoints.explanation: The article provides step-by-step guides to open Inspect Element on Safari (via Advanced settings), Chrome (via right-click or shortcut), and Firefox (via right-click or shortcut) on Mac.

keyPoints.title: Temporarily Modifying Webpages
keyPoints.explanation: Inspect Element allows you to edit webpage text, change images, modify styles and colors, and replace hyperlinks temporarily for testing or experimentation.

keyPoints.title: Important Tips and Considerations
keyPoints.explanation: Changes made through Inspect Element are temporary and visible only on your end; always take screenshots before refreshing, and remember that using it on others' websites for malicious purposes can be illegal.

title.rendered: How to reverse a video on an iPhone (with or without an app)

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Core Limitation: Your iPhone’s built-in Photos and iMovie apps do not have a feature to reverse videos; you must use a third-party app or online tool.
  • The App-Based Solution: The easiest method is to use a free app like Inshot. Simply import your video, tap the “Reverse” tool in the editor, and export the result.
  • The Online Solution: As an alternative, you can use a free online video editor like Clideo or Ezgif to reverse your video directly in your iPhone’s web browser.
  • Dealing with Watermarks: Be aware that many free apps and online tools may add a watermark to your final video, which can sometimes be removed or cropped out later.
  • Future Outlook: While currently not possible, it is hoped that a future version of iOS will add a native video reversal feature directly into the built-in Photos app.

The iPhone has become a go-to tool for editing videos on the fly for many. If you are one of those people and have hit a roadblock trying to reverse a video, you’re not alone. This guide is here to help you get past the frustration and show you quick, straightforward methods to reverse videos right on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Can you reverse a video natively on your iPhone?
  • Reverse a video on your iPhone using a third-party app
  • Reverse a video on your iPhone using an online tool

Can you reverse a video natively on your iPhone?

Sadly, there is no way to reverse a video on an iPhone natively. Neither the Photos nor the iMovie app will help you with it. As a result, you need to use a third-party app or tool. We will discuss a few of them in this guide.

Reverse a video on your iPhone using a third-party app

I have tried several video editing apps to reverse a video on my iPhone. Among these, Inshot worked the best for me. Here’s how you can use it to reverse a video on your iPhone:

  1. Download the Inshot app from the App Store if you haven’t already done so.
  2. Open Inshot and give it permission to access your photos and videos. (You can either provide full access or partial access.)
  3. Tap on the icon titled Video.
  4. Tap the + icon and add the video you want to reverse from the Photos app gallery.

  5. Next, select the same video in the following screen and tap the green checkmark icon below to import it.
  6. You are now on the edit screen. Swipe horizontally on the tools bar above to find the Reverse tool and tap on it.

Your video should now be reversed. But before you export it, follow these steps to remove the watermark from the edited video:

  1. When you open the video, you should see an Inshot watermark in the bottom-right corner. Tap the small x mark on it.
  2. You will see two options. The first is a subscribe button to Inshot Pro, while the second is a Free Remove button. Tap Free Remove to watch an ad and remove the watermark without paying anything.
  3. After watching the entire ad, you will notice the watermark disappear. Tap the export icon on the top right corner, then select the export settings and tap Save.

The edited reversed video will now be saved on your iPhone. You can access it in the Photos app.

For some reason, if you are unable to use the Inshot app or want to explore more options, you can try other similar video editing apps. Below are two of my recommendations:

  • VN Editor: VN Video Editor is a popular video editing app on the iPhone. This app doesn’t add a watermark on the video, but will instead add a small snippet promoting itself at the end of the video, which you can trim out easily.
  • Filmora: Filmora is another decent video editing app with plenty of features. This app allows you to easily reverse any video, but the only issue is that you will get a watermark on the edited video.

Reverse a video on your iPhone using an online tool

If you don’t prefer installing an app, you can use an online video editor to reverse a video on your iPhone. While there are various tools, the one I am using is called Videobolt, which is very simple and quick. Follow these steps to reverse a video using it:

  1. Head to the Videobolt website in your preferred browser on your iPhone.
  2. Tap the upload icon in the middle and select the video you want to reverse. Wait for the video to upload and process.

  3. After the video processing is complete, tap the Reverse & Download button and wait for a popup menu to appear. Then, tap Download to save the reversed video on your iPhone without any watermark.

You can access the edited video in the Files app inside the Downloads folder.

If the above tool is not working for you, here are some alternatives you can try.

  • Clideo.com
  • Ezgif.com

Note that some of these tools may add a watermark to the final video. But usually, the watermark is on the bottom or top of the video, which you can remove by simply cropping it in the Photos app. To learn how, check out our tutorial on how to edit videos on an iPhone.

Signing off…

It is quite surprising that neither of Apple’s editing apps has a built-in tool to reverse videos. We can only hope this changes, though, and Apple adds the functionality to its apps. But until that happens, you can use any of the tools mentioned above to reverse video clips on your iPhone.

You might also like:

  • How to extract audio from video on iPhone and iPad
  • How to turn a Live Photo into a video on your iPhone
  • How to send large video from iPhone

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

title.rendered: How to Use the Dock on iPad (with iPadOS 26 Features)

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What It Is: The iPad Dock is a bar at the bottom of the screen that holds your favorite apps on the left and recent or suggested apps on the right.
  • Access and Customize: Access the Dock by swiping up from the bottom of the screen. You can customize it by dragging apps on or off to create your own shortcuts.
  • Multitasking Hub: The Dock is essential for multitasking; drag an app icon from the Dock over another open app to initiate either Split View or Slide Over.
  • New in iPadOS 26: The upcoming iPadOS 26 will allow you to drag folders directly from the Files app into the Dock, providing instant access to your important documents.
  • A Cleaner Look: For a cleaner look, you can go into your “Home Screen & Multitasking” settings and turn off the option to show recent apps in the Dock.

The Dock on your iPad is more than just a row of app icons. It’s a powerful multitasking tool that gives you fast access to your favorite and recent apps. With iPadOS 26, Apple has upgraded the Dock with a sleek Liquid Glass design, support for folders, and smarter drag-and-drop gestures. In this guide, we’ll show you how to use, customize, and get the most out of your iPad Dock.

Table of Contents
  • What is the iPad Dock?
  • How to Access the Dock on an iPad
  • How to Customize the iPad Dock
    • Remove Suggested and Recent Apps From the Dock
    • Hide App Library in Dock
    • Add and Rearrange Favorite Apps
  • How to Add a Folder to the Dock
  • Multitasking on an iPad with the Dock
  • How to Use Files in Dock Folders

What is the iPad Dock?

The iPad Dock is designed to streamline your workflow by letting you open or switch apps with a single swipe, similar to how the Dock works on a Mac. You can also add folders from the Files app to quickly drag items into other apps.

It appears as a horizontal bar at the bottom of the screen in both portrait and landscape mode. The Dock is divided into two parts:

  • Left Side: Contains your favorite or manually added apps.
  • Right Side: Shows recently used apps, suggested apps, and the App Library (if enabled).

With iPadOS 26, you can now add folders to the right section of the Dock for quick access to your files.

How to Access the Dock on an iPad

The Dock is always visible on the Home Screen. When using an app, swipe up gently from the bottom of the screen to reveal the Dock without exiting the app. Make sure not to swipe too far up, or you’ll return to the Home Screen.

How to Customize the iPad Dock

Apple allows you to personalize your iPad Dock to suit your workflow. From controlling suggested apps to arranging your favorites, here’s how to make it work for you.

Remove Suggested and Recent Apps From the Dock

You can stop iPadOS from automatically showing recently used or suggested apps on the right side of the Dock.

  1. Head to Settings > Home Screen & App Library.
  2. In the Dock section, toggle off Show Suggested and Recent Apps in Dock.

Hide App Library in Dock

To remove the App Library icon from your Dock:

  1. Go to Settings > Home Screen & App Library.
  2. Under the Dock section, toggle off the Show App Library in Dock option.

Add and Rearrange Favorite Apps

With suggested apps and the App Library hidden, you can fully personalize your Dock with apps you use most.

Add apps to the iPad Dock:

  1. Press and hold on any empty space on the iPad Home Screen until all the app icons start to jiggle. Alternatively, long press on an app icon and tap Edit Home Screen.
  2. Now, drag and drop the app icon into the Dock to add it.

Remove apps from the iPad Dock:

  1. Follow the same first step as shown above until you see the jiggling apps and tap the – (minus button) in the top-left corner of the app icon in the Dock.

  2. Then, tap Remove from Home Screen to remove the app from the Dock.

  3. Alternatively, you can drag the app from the Dock and drop it on the Home Screen to remove it from there.

To reorganize the apps in your Dock, simply long-press on an app’s icon until the icons start jiggling, then drag the icons to rearrange them in your preferred fashion.

How to Add a Folder to the Dock

iPadOS 26 lets you pin folders from the Files app directly to your Dock for quick access.

  1. Open the Files app and navigate to On My iPad or iCloud Drive in the left sidebar.
  2. Tap and hold the folder you want to add. Gently drag and don’t lift your finger yet.
  3. Using another finger, swipe up from the bottom of the screen to reveal the Dock.
  4. Drop the folder in the right‑hand section of the Dock, next to the App Library icon.

That’s it! Now you have a folder in your Dock for quick access.

Note: You can only add folders from the Files app. Apple does not yet support folders from third-party apps.

Multitasking on an iPad with the Dock

Thanks to Apple’s powerful M-series chips and iPadOS 26, multitasking on iPad is smoother than ever. The Dock plays a central role in enabling features like Split View and Slide Over.

Slide Over

When you use Slide Over to multitask on your iPad, you can simply drag an app from the Dock onto the screen to open the app in a floating window. This is easy and more convenient than the traditional method of using Slide Over.

Split View

Similarly, when using Split View for multitasking, you can drag an app from the Dock to the edge of the screen to split the display and use two apps simultaneously.

For instance, suppose you are reading an article on Safari and instantly want to take notes. You can swipe up to access the Dock, drag and drop the Notes app and use it in Split View with Safari.

You can check out our detailed guide on iPad multitasking to learn more ways to multitask.

How to Use Files in Dock Folders

Folders in the Dock allow for faster access to important files. Here’s how to get the most from them:

  1. Tap the folder icon in the Dock. It will show a Mac-like menu with files and subfolders right above it.
  2. Tap a file to open it automatically. Most files open in the Files app whereas images and PDFs open in the new Preview app.
  3. If there’s a subfolder, it expands and shows its contents in the same menu.
  4. Touch and drag any item from the Dock folder and drop it into another app like dragging an image into Notes or Pages.

You can also change how you view items. Simple, long‑press the folder icon in the Dock to open options for:

  • View Content As: Fan or Grid
  • Sort By: date modified, name, or size.

Tip: To avoid clutter, tap and hold the folder icon, select Options, then tap Remove from Dock when the folder is no longer needed.

Signing off…

The iPad Dock is an essential productivity tool that often goes unnoticed. With the latest iPadOS 26 enhancements, including folder support and drag-and-drop improvements, it’s more useful than ever. Whether you’re juggling multiple apps or managing files, the Dock helps you get things done faster and more efficiently.

FAQs

Can I completely hide the Dock on the iPad?

No. iPadOS does not allow you to hide the Dock completely. It remains accessible on the Home Screen and within apps using a swipe gesture.

How many apps can the Dock hold?

The number depends on your iPad’s screen size and resolution. Most models hold at least 13 apps, while larger models like the iPad Pro can hold up to 17 apps.

  • How to use Stage Manager on iPad and Mac
  • iPad trackpad gestures: A complete guide for effortless navigation
  • Hide or Show the Dock on Mac

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only in the European Union as of late 2025. Other regions remain closed to sideloading for now. How much commission does Apple now charge? itemListElement.text: Tap and hold on an empty space until icons jiggle.

step.name: Add the app to the Dock
step.text: Drag and drop the desired app icon into the Dock to add it.

step.name: Enter edit mode
step.text: Press and hold on an empty area of the Home Screen until apps jiggle.

Begin dragging it without releasing your finger.

itemListElement.text: Drag the folder into position on the right-hand side of the Dock.
Release it to place it there.

blockGraphs.question: Can I completely hide the Dock on the iPad?
blockGraphs.answer: No. iPadOS does not allow you to hide the Dock completely. It remains accessible on the Home Screen and within apps using a swipe gesture.

blockGraphs.question: How many apps can the Dock hold?
blockGraphs.answer: The number depends on your iPad's screen size and resolution. Most models hold at least 13 apps, while larger models like the iPad Pro can hold up to 17 apps.

keyPoints.title: What is the iPad Dock?
keyPoints.explanation: The iPad Dock is a horizontal bar at the bottom of the screen that provides quick access to favorite and recent apps, divided into two parts for easy multitasking.

keyPoints.title: How to Access the Dock on an iPad
keyPoints.explanation: The Dock is always visible on the Home Screen and can be revealed while using an app by swiping up gently from the bottom of the screen.

keyPoints.title: How to Customize the iPad Dock
keyPoints.explanation: Users can personalize their Dock by removing suggested apps, hiding the App Library, and adding or rearranging favorite apps for quicker access.

keyPoints.title: Adding Folders to the Dock
keyPoints.explanation: Folders from the Files app can be directly added to the Dock in iPadOS 26 by dragging them into the right section of the Dock for fast file access.

keyPoints.title: Multitasking with the Dock
keyPoints.explanation: The Dock enhances multitasking features like Split View and Slide Over, allowing easy drag-and-drop of apps for a more efficient workflow.

title.rendered: How to Use WhatsApp Polls to Settle Any Group Chat Fast

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • WhatsApp Polls help simplify group decisions by letting you ask a question with up to 12 multiple-choice answers in any chat or group.
  • Votes are public and uneditable so you can see who voted for what, but you’ll need to delete and recreate a poll to change it.
  • Available on mobile and desktop apps—tap the attach (+ or paperclip) icon, choose Poll, then add your question and answer options.
  • Results update in real time and everyone can see the tally and voters for each option as soon as someone casts a vote.
  • Polls can’t be edited or made anonymous, so double-check your question before posting and keep your app updated if polls don’t show.

If you and your contacts are unsure about where to eat, picking the next team meeting time, or just settling a debate about the best movie of the year, the WhatsApp Polls feature is your best bet. It works in individual chats, group conversations, and even WhatsApp Business accounts. Instead of scrolling through dozens of messages and counting emoji reactions, polls on WhatsApp let everyone vote, making group chats a lot less chaotic.

This post details how to create polls on WhatsApp, along with tips to get the most out of them.

Table of Contents
  • What Are WhatsApp Polls?
  • How to Create a Poll in WhatsApp on iPhone or Android
  • How to Create a WhatsApp Poll on Desktop or Web
  • Managing and Viewing Poll Results
  • Can You Edit or Delete a WhatsApp Poll?
  • Best Practices for Using Polls in WhatsApp Groups
  • WhatsApp Poll Limitations and Tips
  • Troubleshooting: Why Can't I Create Polls on WhatsApp?
  • Make Decisions Easier with WhatsApp Polls…

What Are WhatsApp Polls?

Introduced in 2022, WhatsApp Polls is a simple yet effective feature that allows you to ask a question and offer multiple answer options in a chat, whether it’s individual or group-based.

Once sent, you and the other participants in the chat can vote for one or multiple options (if enabled) to reach a mutual decision, something that’s often hard to achieve in a typical conversation.

Here’s what makes WhatsApp polls useful:

  • You can add up to 12 choices per poll.
  • You can allow or restrict multiple answers.
  • Everyone in the chat can see who voted and which options are leading.
  • It works in both group chats and private conversations.

How to Create a Poll in WhatsApp on iPhone or Android

Creating a poll on WhatsApp is simple and takes just a few taps:

  1. Open WhatsApp and enter the individual or group chat where you want to create a poll.
  2. Tap the “+” icon on iPhone or the paperclip icon on Android next to the text field.
  3. Select Poll from the options grid.
  4. Enter the poll question in the dedicated field.
  5. Add your response options—up to 12.
  6. Choose whether to allow multiple answers.
  7. Tap the Send button to publish the poll.

How to Create a WhatsApp Poll on Desktop or Web

Creating polls on WhatsApp Web or desktop is just as easy:

  1. Go to WhatsApp Web or open the WhatsApp desktop app on Mac or Windows.
  2. Open the individual or group chat where you want to post the poll.
  3. Click the “+” button next to the text field and choose Poll.
  4. Enter your question and list the answer options.
  5. Toggle “Allow multiple answers” on or off.
  6. Click Send to share the poll.

Managing and Viewing Poll Results

Once your poll is live in the chat:

  • Participants (including you) can tap to vote on one or more options.
  • If allowed, users can select multiple answers.
  • Votes are not anonymous; everyone can see who voted and how.
  • Results update in real-time within the chat.
  • Tap “View votes” to see who voted for each option.

Can You Edit or Delete a WhatsApp Poll?

Unfortunately, you can’t edit a poll once it’s sent. To make changes, you must delete the existing poll and create a new one.

To delete a poll:

  1. Long-press the Poll and tap Delete in the pop-up menu.
  2. Next, tap the Trash Can icon (Delete) at the bottom left corner.
  3. Choose “Delete for everyone” (if within the time limit) or “Delete for me.”

Best Practices for Using Polls in WhatsApp Groups

Here are some tips to make your polls more effective and less disruptive:

  • Keep the question concise: Avoid confusing or overly detailed questions.
  • Limit the number of answers: 3–5 options are ideal for clarity.
  • Use multiple answers wisely: Disable if you need a clear winner.
  • Stay practical: Use polls for scheduling, quick decisions, or opinions.
  • Avoid overuse: Too many polls can annoy group members.

WhatsApp Poll Limitations and Tips

While polls are useful (Apple even introduced polls in iMessage), they do come with a few drawbacks:

Troubleshooting: Why Can’t I Create Polls on WhatsApp?

If you’re having trouble creating or voting in a WhatsApp poll, try these solutions:

Make Decisions Easier with WhatsApp Polls…

Now you know how useful WhatsApp Polls can be, whether it’s organizing lunch plans with friends or collecting quick feedback at work. It’s a simple but powerful feature to bring order to your chats.

Go ahead, open that group, drop a poll, and let the voting begin.

  • How to delete a WhatsApp group on your iPhone or Android

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

keyPoints.title: Introduction to WhatsApp Polls
keyPoints.explanation: WhatsApp Polls, introduced in 2022, is a feature that allows users to ask questions with multiple response options in chats, making group decision-making clearer and easier.

keyPoints.title: Features and Limitations of WhatsApp Polls
keyPoints.explanation: Each poll can have up to 12 options, with privacy showing who voted, but votes are not anonymous, and the feature can't be edited after creation; deleting and recreating is necessary for changes.

keyPoints.title: Creating WhatsApp Polls on Different Devices
keyPoints.explanation: Polls can be easily created on both mobile (iPhone and Android) and desktop/web versions by selecting the Poll option and entering your question and answers.

keyPoints.title: Managing and Viewing Poll Results
keyPoints.explanation: Participants can vote and see real-time results, including who voted for each option; votes are visible to all, and results update as votes come in.

keyPoints.title: Best Practices and Troubleshooting for Polls
keyPoints.explanation: To ensure effective polls, keep questions concise and options limited; troubleshooting tips include updating the app and checking network connectivity if issues arise.

title.rendered: How to screenshot on Snapchat without them knowing (3 tested methods)

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Core Privacy Feature: Snapchat is designed to notify users when their snaps, stories, or chats are screenshotted in order to protect user privacy and maintain trust.
  • Old Methods No Longer Work: Due to frequent updates, old tricks like using Airplane Mode, screen recording, or clearing the cache no longer prevent the other person from being notified.
  • Potential Workarounds: Some workarounds, like using a second device to photograph the screen or certain screen mirroring setups, may still bypass notifications, but are not foolproof.
  • What Triggers a Notification: A notification is only sent when you screenshot a snap, story, or chat; screenshotting a user’s profile or the map will not trigger an alert.
  • Ethical Considerations: Remember to use any screenshot method ethically and with respect for the other person’s privacy, as Snapchat continuously works to patch these workarounds.

Snapchat is popular for its unique feature of making snaps disappear after viewing. However, if you want to save a snap/story on your iPhone, the only way is to screenshot it. But the problem is Snapchat notifies the sender when you take a screenshot of their snap! Worry not; here, I’ll share some tested workaround ways to take a screenshot on Snapchat on iPhone without triggering the notification.

Table of Contents
  • Why does Snapchat notify the sender if I screenshot their snap?
  • How to take screenshots on Snapchat without notifying the sender
    • 1. Use another device to click the Snap
    • 2. Mirror your iPhone screen
    • 3. Record screen on Snapchat web
  • Methods no longer work to take a screenshot on Snapchat

Why does Snapchat notify the sender if I screenshot their snap?

Snapchat was designed to allow users to share moments freely without fear that their content would be saved or shared without consent. This helps foster trust, a sense of security, and transparency among users. It is also important in reducing instances of cyberbullying, harassment, or the unauthorized distribution of personal images.

That’s why when you take a screenshot of someone’s Snap or chat, they will see an alert on the chat indicating your action. Moreover, saving someone’s content without permission can break their trust and, in some cases, may even have legal implications.

Therefore, before attempting any of the methods below, consider asking for the sender’s consent or ensuring your actions are appropriate.

How to take screenshots on Snapchat without notifying the sender

Unfortunately, Snapchat can detect most screenshots and screen recording methods. We will discuss which methods don’t work anymore to save Snapchat snaps without alerting the sender in the post.

Below are my tried and tested ways to help you bypass its notification system. Use these techniques responsibly and ethically:

1. Use another device to click the Snap

This is one of the simplest and most reliable methods, as Snapchat cannot detect external devices. Thus, screenshot notifications will not be triggered.

Here’s how to do it:

  1. Launch Snapchat on your iPhone.
  2. Go to the Chat tab and open the Snap you want to save.
  3. Now, take a second device, such as a phone or camera, to take a picture or video of Snap.
Note I recommend shooting a video of your screen, as you might be unsure of the length of the Snap. Also, you can replay the Snap once so capture the snap in the first attempt.

The only issue is the quality of the saved image or video depends on the camera of the second device.

2. Mirror your iPhone screen

Another approach is to cast your phone screen to another device and discreetly record its screen. Here, I am using my Mac to cast my iPhone screen.

  1. First, open your Mac and press Command + Shift + 5 keys.
  2. Select the fourth option in the Screenshot toolbar to capture your entire screen and click Record.

  3. Now, open your iPhone Control Center and tap the plus icon at the top left.
  4. Select Add a Control and choose Screen Mirroring. Tap an empty space to save it.

  5. Next, tap the Screen Mirroring control and select your external device name. Here, I selected my Mac.

  6. Swipe up to close the Control Center and launch Snapchat.
  7. Go to the chat and open the Snap you want to save.
  8. Once you view the Snap, close Snapchat and stop screen mirroring from the Control Center.
  9. Finally, stop screen recording on your Mac by clicking the pause icon on the menu bar.

Now, you can play the screen recording on your Mac and take a screenshot of the Snap specifically if you want. This method is useful for saving high-quality Snapchat snaps without them knowing.

3. Record screen on Snapchat web

If you have a PC or Mac, you can use it to save snaps of others. I tried the method on my Mac using the Brave browser, and it worked perfectly.

  1. Go to Snapchat’s website using your preferred browser and login to your account.
  2. Next, go to another tab and start screen recording by pressing cmd+shift+5.
  3. Move back to the Snapchat tab and open the Snap you want to save.
  4. Once done, again go to another tab and turn off the screen recording from the menu bar.

Snapchat Web does not always detect screen recording on PCs, but this depends on the method you use.

Methods no longer work to take a screenshot on Snapchat

Snapchat regularly updates its app to close loopholes that allow users to bypass its screenshot detection. Here are some methods that no longer work reliably:

  • iPhone Mirroring Feature: With iOS 18, you can view your iPhone screen on your Mac thanks to the iPhone Mirroring feature. Accessing the iPhone screen on your Mac and taking a screenshot from there used to work. However, Snapchat now detects screenshots taken during mirroring.
  • Snap Remix: Snapchat’s Snap Remix feature lets users add their content upon someone’s Snap. If you select to remix someone’s Snap and take a screenshot before sending it, the sender is notified immediately.
  • Recording your screen: Your iPhone comes with a built-in screen recorder. So, you may think of recording the screen of your iPhone while using Snapchat and storing the recordings as video. But this method no longer works. We have tried screen recording, and it does send notifications!
  • Turning on Airplane Mode: This is an old trick that might work in older versions of Snapchat and iOS. But not now! You may think that Airplane mode cuts off all networks, so how can Snapchat send screenshot notifications? Actually, Snapchat is pre-loaded. Therefore, the server will know about your activity on the app.
  • Clearing the cache: Most old Snapchat users have tried this trick. After disconnecting from the internet, you take a screenshot and then delete the cache. So, there must be no records of your activity when the app was reconnected to the internet. But for now, Snapchat has closed this loophole.
  • Third-Party Screen Recorders: This is another old solution that no longer works in the current version of Snapchat. Regardless of the third-party screen recorder you use (and there are countless choices on the app store), the sender will be verified of a screen recording.

Signing off…

While there are ways to screenshot Snapchat on an iPhone without the sender knowing, it’s important to use these methods ethically and responsibly. Always prioritize respecting others’ privacy and trust. We don’t suggest bypassing Snapchat’s privacy protections for malicious purposes.

Also, remember that Snapchat may update its security patches at any moment. So, what works today may not work tomorrow!

FAQs

Is it legal to screenshot Snaps?

Laws regarding taking screenshots of private content vary by region. In many cases, saving someone’s images without their consent can be a violation of privacy or intellectual property laws. Always ensure your actions comply with local regulations.

How to get rid of screenshot notifications on Snapchat?

Unfortunately, there is no legitimate way to disable Snapchat’s screenshot notification feature. It is a built-in privacy measure to protect users. I recommend trying it with a snap you send to yourself to check if it’s a hit or miss. Then, only use it for others to avoid embarrassment.

Does screenshotting on Snapchat Web notify users?

Snapchat web is designed to blur the snaps and chat when you attempt to take a screenshot. So, you can’t directly screenshot Snapchat on the web version. You may try the method I mentioned in the post instead.

Does Snapchat notify when you screenshot the home screen?

No, Snapchat does not notify users when you screenshot the home screen of the app. Notifications are triggered only when you screenshot or screen record Snaps, chats, or stories.

How to see who screenshotted your public Snapchat Story?

To see who screenshotted your public Snapchat Story, open Snapchat, tap your avatar at the top left, and select My Story. Swipe up on the Story to view the list of viewers. Look for a double-arrow icon next to the names of viewers—this indicates that they took a screenshot of your Story.

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

title.rendered: What to do if you see orange or green dot on iPhone screen

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What The Dots Mean: The orange dot in your status bar means an app is using your microphone, while the green dot means an app is actively using your camera.
  • Identifying the App: To see which app recently used your camera or microphone, simply swipe down to open the Control Center; the app’s name will appear at the top.
  • Managing Permissions: You can control app access by going to Settings > Privacy & Security, where you can individually grant or revoke microphone and camera permissions.
  • Accessibility Option: For better visibility, an accessibility option in “Display & Text Size” settings allows you to change the orange dot into an orange square.
  • Troubleshooting: If a privacy dot seems stuck or appears unexpectedly, try force restarting your iPhone or check for an iOS update to resolve potential software glitches.

Imagine you just bought your first iPhone and are set to enjoy the brand-new iOS experience. But then, you start seeing an orange or green dot on your iPhone screen as you use it and wonder what it signifies.

Well, there is nothing to be worried about; these dots are Apple’s way of informing you about something important during your daily use. Keep reading to find out what they mean and how to turn them off.

Table of Contents
  • What do green dot and orange dot mean on iPhone?
  • How to check which app is using microphone on iPhone
    • Turn the orange dot into a square
  • How to turn off green dot on iPhone
  • What to do if orange or green dot appears randomly on iPhone
    • 1. Update iOS version
    • 2. Uninstall apps
    • 3. Force restart your iPhone

What do green dot and orange dot mean on iPhone?

Apple introduced orange and green dots as part of the slew of privacy features for iPhones with the release of iOS 14. Here’s a breakdown of what each of them means.

Whenever you open an app on your iPhone that accesses the microphone, you will see an orange dot appear at the top of your iPhone screen (Dynamic Island if you use iPhone 14 Pro or above). You will notice this behavior with apps like the Notes app, WhatsApp, or Messages that access your microphone to execute different functions like voice calls or voice-to-text features.

On the other hand, a green dot indicates the use of the camera only or the camera and the microphone by an app installed on your iPhone. This can be WhatsApp trying to access your camera during video calls or when you are setting up Face ID on your iPhone for the first time by scanning your face using the front camera.

How to check which app is using microphone on iPhone

When you see an orange dot on your iPhone’s screen, you can check which app triggered it. This allows you to keep an eye on which app is using your iPhone’s microphone (and how often).

All you have to do is swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen to bring up the Control Center. Then, look at the top of the screen, and you will see the name of the app that is using (or has recently used) the microphone.

If you want to disable an app’s microphone access, follow the steps below:

  1. Open Settings and select Privacy & Security.
  2. Tap on Microphone, and you will see a list of apps having access to your iPhone’s microphone on the next screen.
  3. To disable an app from using the microphone, tap the toggle next to its name.

Turn the orange dot into a square

Apple lets you change the shape of the orange dot if it is hard for you to differentiate between colors. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open Settings > Accessibility and select Display & Text Size.
  2. Tap the toggle next to Differentiate Without Color.

This will now make the orange dot appear as a square.

How to turn off green dot on iPhone

You can disable specific apps from using the Camera app on your iPhone. Doing so will no longer trigger the green dot when you use these apps. This is what you need to do:

  1. Open Settings and select Privacy & Security.
  2. Tap on Camera, and you will see a list of apps having access to your iPhone’s camera.
  3. To prevent an app from using the camera, tap the toggle next to its name.

What to do if orange or green dot appears randomly on iPhone

If you see the orange or green dot randomly appear on your iPhone, it might just be a bug in the current version of iOS you have installed on your iPhone. Here are a few solutions that I recommend you to try.

1. Update iOS version

Check if you are running the latest version of iOS on your iPhone. If you are not, you should update your iPhone.

  1. Open Settings and select General.
  2. Tap on Software Update and see if a new version of iOS is available to install on your device.
  3. If available, download and install the update, and it should remove the software bug that may be causing the issue.

2. Uninstall apps

If there are any apps installed on your iPhone that you don’t use frequently, try uninstalling them. Yes, you have turned off camera or microphone access for those apps. But you can still try uninstalling them to see if the problem gets solved.

  1. Long-press on the app’s icon on your iPhone’s Home Screen.
  2. Select Remove App > Delete App and then tap Delete to confirm your choice.

3. Force restart your iPhone

After removing the apps, try to force restart your iPhone. This will reload all your apps and functions on the device.

Wrapping up…

As you just saw, the orange and green dots in your iPhone status bar serve a really useful purpose, helping you understand when an app is using your device’s sensitive hardware so you can take appropriate action when something seems suspicious. While Apple does not allow you to get rid of these indicators completely, you can turn them off for specific apps and even change the shape of the orange and green dots if you want.

FAQs

What to do if orange dot or green dot still doesn’t turn off?

You can visit the official Apple service center to get your iPhone software checked by experts.

How to fix iPhone microphone not working?

If your iPhone microphone is not working while using an app, there are a lot of working solutions that you can try for yourself.

Can you completely get rid of orange dot on iPhone?
Due to Apple’s strict privacy policies, you cannot really get rid of the orange dot on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the download location for each file in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Mac, Yes! You can set Safari to ask where to save each file. Just go to Safari > Settings > General, then choose Ask for each download for the file download location. On iPhone or iPad, No. Safari doesn’t let you choose a folder for each file. You can only set one default download location.

mainEntity.name: Will changing the download location affect iCloud syncing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. If you choose a folder inside iCloud Drive, your downloads will sync across your Apple devices. If you pick a folder that’s not in iCloud Drive (like "On My iPhone" or a local folder on Mac), the files will stay only on that device and won’t sync with others.

mainEntity.name: Does this change affect other browsers like Chrome or Firefox?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Changing Safari’s download location only affects Safari. Other browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge have their own separate settings for where to save downloads—you’ll need to adjust those separately in each browser’s settings.

mainEntity.name: Is sideloading allowed on iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only in the European Union as of late 2025. Other regions remain closed to sideloading for now. How much commission does Apple now charge? Commissions in the EU can drop as low as 10-13% for small businesses with external payments, and up to 17-20% for direct App Store payments. Elsewhere, the standard 15-30% still applies. How do these changes affect app users? Users in the EU will enjoy access to more apps and payment options, but should be aware of new security considerations.

@graph.name: How to Check Which App Is Using Microphone on iPhone
@graph.description: View and manage which apps have microphone access on your iPhone to protect your privacy.

step.name: Open Privacy settings
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone and tap Privacy & Security.

itemListElement.text: Open Settings.
Tap Privacy & Security.

step.name: Access Microphone permissions
step.text: Select Microphone to see a list of apps that have access to your iPhone’s microphone.

itemListElement.text: Tap Microphone.
Review the list of apps with microphone access.

step.name: Disable microphone access for apps
step.text: Turn off the toggle next to any app to revoke its microphone access.

itemListElement.text: Find the app in the list.
Switch the toggle off.

@graph.name: How to Turn Off Green Dot on iPhone
@graph.description: Disable camera access for specific apps on your iPhone to prevent the green dot indicator from appearing.

step.name: Open Privacy settings
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone and tap Privacy & Security.

itemListElement.text: Launch the Settings app.
Tap Privacy & Security.

step.name: Access Camera permissions
step.text: Select Camera to see a list of apps that have access to your iPhone’s camera.

itemListElement.text: Tap Camera.
Review the list of apps with camera access.

step.name: Disable camera access for apps
step.text: Turn off the toggle next to any app to revoke its camera access and stop the green dot from appearing when that app is open.

itemListElement.text: Locate the app in the list.
Switch the toggle off.

keyPoints.title: Meaning of orange and green dots on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: Orange dots indicate microphone use, while green dots signify camera usage, both serving as privacy indicators introduced with iOS 14.

keyPoints.title: Checking app usage of microphone and camera
keyPoints.explanation: You can view which apps are using your microphone or camera by swiping down from the top-right corner to access the Control Center, where app names are displayed.

keyPoints.title: Disabling app access to microphone and camera
keyPoints.explanation: To prevent certain apps from using your microphone or camera, navigate to Settings > Privacy & Security, then disable access for specific apps.

keyPoints.title: Changing the shape of privacy dots
keyPoints.explanation: Apple allows you to change the shape of the orange dot to a square via Accessibility settings under 'Display & Text Size' for easier differentiation.

keyPoints.title: Troubleshooting persistent privacy dots
keyPoints.explanation: If the dots appear randomly, updating iOS, uninstalling unused apps, or force restarting your iPhone may resolve potential bugs causing this issue.

title.rendered: How to connect and use a mouse with iPad like a pro

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Requirements: To use a mouse with your iPad, you need a compatible Bluetooth or wired mouse and your device must be running iPadOS 13.4 or newer.
  • Connecting Bluetooth: To connect a Bluetooth mouse, enable Bluetooth on your iPad, put the mouse in pairing mode, and then select it from the list in your settings.
  • Connecting Wired: For a wired mouse, plug it into your iPad’s port. You may need a USB-C or Lightning to USB adapter if the connectors do not match.
  • Customizing Your Mouse: After connecting, you can customize pointer speed, appearance, and button actions by going to Settings > Accessibility > Touch > AssistiveTouch.
  • The Main Benefit: Using a mouse transforms your iPad into a powerful productivity tool, making tasks like editing documents, navigating spreadsheets, and multitasking much faster.

I have been using the iPad extensively for the past few days and was really missing the trackpad that I was so used to on my MacBook. Then I connected a mouse to the iPad, which significantly changed the game for me; I can now do almost everything that I could on my Mac and as swiftly. Let me take you through how I did that and how you can, too, use a mouse on your iPad.

Table of Contents
  • What you need to use a mouse with iPad?
  • How to connect a mouse to your iPad
    • Connecting a Bluetooth mouse to an iPad
    • Connecting a wired mouse to an iPad
  • Configuring mouse settings on iPad
    • Enable AssistiveTouch
    • Customize pointer options
    • Assign custom actions to mouse buttons
  • Benefits of using a mouse with iPad
  • Why isn't my mouse working on my iPad?

What you need to use a mouse with iPad?

Connecting a mouse or an external trackpad/touchpad to your iPad requires some pre-requisites. Here they are:

  • Your iPad should be running iPadOS 13.4 or later (It can be an iPad Pro, Air, Mini, or the regular iPad.)
  • You should have a dedicated mouse. (It can be wired or Bluetooth.)

Check out our buying guide for the best Bluetooth mouse for iPad.

How to connect a mouse to your iPad

Follow the steps below to connect a mouse to your iPad. Note that I am using the Apple Magic Mouse 2nd Gen to demonstrate the process, but the same steps should work on any other mouse.

Connecting a Bluetooth mouse to an iPad

If you own a Bluetooth mouse, you can connect it to your iPad like this:

  1. Head to Settings → Bluetooth.
  2. Turn on Bluetooth and let it perform a scan.
  3. You will see the name of your mouse appear under the Other Devices section. Tap on it to connect.

Once the connection is successful, your mouse will appear in the My Devices section.

Connecting a wired mouse to an iPad

Firstly, check the port on your iPad and Mouse. If both of them match, for instance, your iPad and Mouse have USB C, you can just plug it in to connect. Otherwise, you will need a dongle to connect. Here are some dongles we recommend:

  • IVSHOWCO Lightning to USB Adapter – If you have a Lightning iPad and a USB-A mouse
  • Syntech’s USB-C to USB-A adapter – If you have a USB-C iPad and a USB-A mouse

Choose the one based on the port on your devices.

Configuring mouse settings on iPad

Now that you have successfully connected your mouse to your iPad, you will see a small round, grey-colored cursor on your screen. It is called the mouse pointer. But before you start enjoying the newly obtained mouse energy on your iPad, you should know about the following settings to fully utilize the mouse’s capabilities.

Enable AssistiveTouch

AssistiveTouch enhances the mouse experience on your iPad by allowing you to enable sound when pressing a pointer device. You also need to enable it to configure other options, which we will discuss below. Let’s see how to turn on AssistiveTouch.

  1. Head to Settings → Accessibility.
  2. Turn on AssistiveTouch.
  3. [OPTIONAL] Scroll down, tap Virtual Trackpad and turn it on. You may find it useful when the mouse wheel is broken.

  4. Now, go back and find Sound on Click. Toggle it on to get a sound upon every mouse button click.

Customize pointer options

You can customize the mouse pointer to change its appearance, animations, and scrolling speed. Follow these steps:

  1. Open Settings and head to Accessibility.
  2. Scroll down and tap Pointer Control.

  3. Here, you will see several options to customize the appearance and behavior of pointer like Increase Contrast, Automatically Hide Pointer, Pointer Animations, Scrolling Speed, and more. Modify them as per your preference.

Assign custom actions to mouse buttons

You can also set specific actions for each mouse button. This becomes useful when you use a mouse with multiple buttons and want to assign different tasks to each one. Here’s how to set them:

  1. Open Settings and head to Accessibility → Touch.

  2. Next, go to AssistiveTouch > Devices.
  3. Tap on the name of your connected mouse under the Connected Devices section.

  4. Tap Customize Additional Buttons.

  5. Now, a pop-up will ask you to press the button you want to customize. Single-click that button on your mouse.

  6. After the click, a menu will open with all the actions you can assign to the button. Select your preferred action.

  7. Similarly, you can customize the other mouse button, too. Go back, tap Customize Additional Buttons again, and repeat the same steps.

Benefits of using a mouse with iPad

Using a mouse has several benefits:

  • Editing: With iPads getting more powerful year-on-year, thanks to the M series chips, you can easily edit videos and photos on them. This is when a mouse comes in handy, making it easier to select, drag, and cut items on the screen.
  • Copy-pasting: When you use an iPad to write or edit documents and notes, you can easily select, copy, and paste with a mouse like on your traditional computers.
  • Navigation: Navigating your iPad with a mouse is faster and easier. You can scroll faster, access menus with just a click, and assign shortcuts if your mouse supports multiple buttons.
  • Multitasking: If you love to multitask on your iPad, a mouse may elevate your experience by making it simpler to switch between apps and resize app windows.

If you’re using Apple’s Magic Mouse, learning advanced Magic Mouse gestures can make navigation even smoother and help you work faster across apps.

Why isn’t my mouse working on my iPad?

There can be multiple reasons for your mouse not working with your iPad. Here are some possible causes and solutions:

  • Non-compatibility: Your iPad may not be compatible with mouse usage. Scroll to the top of this article and check for compatibility before trying again.
  • Loose or faulty wire/dongle: If you are using a wired mouse, check for a loose connection or faulty wire/dongle.
  • Outdated software: You might not be on the latest version of iPadOS. So, check and update your software before trying to connect your mouse.
  • Minor glitches: Sometimes, the software has minor glitches, which you can solve by restarting your iPad. Try that and see if it works.

Signing off…

Most people are unaware that you can use a mouse to get the most out of your iPad. But as you just saw, using a mouse with your iPad can serve you in multiple ways you may not be aware of—unless you try it yourself. The support for such versatile accessories makes the iPad an all-in-one device that you can use for entertainment as well as work.

Also read:

  • How to use iPad trackpad gestures like a pro
  • How to use Stage Manager on iPad and Mac
  • Magic Trackpad vs Magic Mouse: What should you buy?

mainEntity.name: How do I leave Family Sharing on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re 13 years and older, you can leave the group from Settings > Family > [your name] > Stop Using Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my data if I leave my family group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personal data stays safe, but you lose access to shared content like calendars, photo albums, and reminders, subscriptions, and services.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see the “Leave Family” option?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be under 13, have Screen Time on, or not be signed in to your Appe Account correctly.

mainEntity.name: Can a child under 13 leave Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the organizer must remove or transfer the child’s account.

mainEntity.name: Will my Apple Music subscription be canceled if I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if it was family-shared; you'll need to buy your own plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I rejoin Family Sharing after leaving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the organizer invites you again or you start/join a new group. Note that you can only switch Family Sharing groups once a year.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a child from Family Sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As organizer, you need to ask other guardians to invite the child account to a different family group in-person and approve the request from your iPhone. Once done, you can remove them from Settings > Family > [child name] > Remove from Family Sharing.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the shared payment method?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will no longer apply to your purchases; you must add your own payment method.

mainEntity.name: If I leave family sharing will they be notified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, family members get a notification when someone leaves or is removed from the group.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for the Explore page to learn my interests again?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no set timeframe. Instagram’s algorithm typically takes a few days to a week to adjust, depending on how actively you engage with new content. Consistently liking, commenting, and following accounts aligned with your interests speeds up the process. If you’re still seeing old content, keep marking it as Not Interested to refine the feed faster.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Explore page show things I don’t like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s Explore page is based on your past activity, likes, saves, searches, and posts you interact with. If you engage with something by mistake or your interests change, the algorithm might still show related content.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to clear my Instagram Explore page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using the built-in Reset suggested content settings is the best way to go. This will wipe your current suggestions so Instagram can build your feed from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing my cache reset my Explore page on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing your cache will not directly reset your Instagram Explore page. However, it removes the old temporary files which may give you a fresh start.

mainEntity.name: What happens when I click "Not Interested" on Instagram?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram hides that post and reduces similar content in your Explore page over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I undo a reset of my suggested posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once you reset, your old suggestions are gone, and Instagram starts learning your interest like the first time.

mainEntity.name: Will resetting my Explore page affect my main feed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your main feed stays the same because it’s based on accounts you follow, not Explore suggestions. Both follows different algorithms to curate content.
